The transition metal dichalcogenide material $2H$-NbS$_2$ exhibits incipient charge-density-wave behavior along with a well-developed superconducting state, creating a scenario where the local lattice instabilities play a crucial role. Here we present how an individual magnetic atom on $2H$-NbS$_2$ can be applied as a local sensor to reveal hidden crystal-field modulations. By manipulating the adatom across the surface with the tip of a scanning tunneling microscope, we measure variations in the Yu-Shiba-Rusinov (YSR) excitation spectra and map the local environment around an intrinsic point defect. We find that while the superconducting state is spatially uniform, the YSR excitation energy strongly depends on the position of the atom. We determine that the main contribution to this effect originates from variations in the local crystal-field environment. These results establish a new approach to investigate crystal-field modulations at the atomic scale and reveal how defects and lattice instabilities shape the atomic landscape of an incipient charge-density-wave material.
summary:
层状材料中多个量子相之间的相互作用可能会导致初期的量子行为，其中材料的基态接近相变并且对局部无序敏感。过渡金属二硫属化物材料 $2H$-NbS$_2$ 表现出初期的电荷密度波行为以及发达的超导态，创造了局部晶格不稳定性发挥关键作用的场景。在这里，我们展示了如何将 $2H$-NbS$_2$ 上的单个磁性原子用作本地传感器来揭示隐藏的晶体场调制。通过使用扫描隧道显微镜的尖端操纵表面上的吸附原子，我们测量了 Yu-Shiba-Rusinov (YSR) 激发光谱的变化，并绘制了固有点缺陷周围的局部环境。我们发现，虽然超导态在空间上是均匀的，但 YSR 激发能强烈依赖于原子的位置。我们确定这种效应的主要贡献源于局部晶体场环境的变化。

这些结果建立了一种在原子尺度上研究晶体场调制的新方法，并揭示了缺陷和晶格不稳定性如何塑造初始电荷密度波材料的原子景观。

title: Disorder-robust trivial Majorana-like states from smooth confinement in chiral superconducting nanowires
abstract: Near-zero-energy states in Majorana nanowires can arise from topologically trivial mechanisms such as smooth spatial inhomogeneity and disorder, making zero-energy pinning alone insufficient evidence of bulk topology. Here we identify a real-space mechanism governing their robustness to symmetry-preserving disorder. For a chiral-symmetric Bogoliubov-de Gennes Hamiltonian, we decompose a low-energy state into two normalized components of opposite chirality and show that disorder-induced splitting is bounded by their spatial overlap. We demonstrate this result in a finite Rashba nanowire with smooth chemical potential and pairing profiles. Below the bulk topological transition, smooth confinement produces partially separated chiral components with exponentially small overlap, yielding globally trivial Majorana-like Andreev bound states that remain near zero energy even under strong scalar, nonmagnetic disorder. The chiral overlap therefore provides a direct diagnostic of the protection of low-energy states against local perturbations, independent of the bulk topological invariant.
summary: 马约拉纳纳米线中的近零能量态可能是由拓扑上微不足道的机制产生的，例如平滑的空间不均匀性和无序性，使得零能量钉扎本身不足以证明体拓扑。在这里，我们确定了一种真实空间机制来控制它们对对称性保持无序的鲁棒性。对于手性对称的 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 哈密顿量，我们将低能态分解为相反手性的两个归一化分量，并表明无序引起的分裂受其空间重叠的限制。我们在具有平滑化学势和配对分布的有限 Rashba 纳米线中证明了这一结果。在体拓扑转变之下，平滑限制产生部分分离的手性成分，其重叠度呈指数级小，产生全局平凡的类马约拉纳安德烈夫束缚态，即使在强标量、非磁性无序下，该束缚态仍保持接近于零的能量。因此，手性重叠提供了对低能态免受局部扰动的保护的直接诊断，独立于体拓扑不变量。

title: Anomalous temperature dependence of polaron mobility in a nonlinear double-well potential: unbiased X-propagator approach
abstract: We develop an unbiased X-propagator method for calculating finite-temperature optical conductivity $\sigma(\omega)$ and dc mobility $\mu$ for arbitrary nonlinear electron-phonon interaction. We apply it to a polaron coupled to a double-well lattice potential, a minimal model for strongly anharmonic polar materials. At moderate coupling, the mobility exhibits three temperature regimes associated with confinement within one well, thermal competition with the barrier, and barrier-insensitive high-temperature dynamics. This sequence produces a concave temperature dependence of the mobility that is absent in conventional linear-coupling polaron models. At strong coupling, the mobility becomes nonmonotonic, and its temperature evolution is reflected in a characteristic redistribution of optical spectral weight. For parameters relevant to SrTiO$_3$, our results qualitatively reproduce both the anomalous concave mobility and the onset of violation of the Mott-Ioffe-Regel limit, thereby supporting nonlinear coupling to a soft anharmonic lattice mode as a microscopic mechanism for anomalous transport in dilute polar metals.
summary: 我们开发了一种无偏 X 传播器方法，用于计算任意非线性电子声子相互作用的有限温度光导率 $\sigma(\omega)$ 和直流迁移率 $\mu$。我们将其应用于与双阱晶格势耦合的极化子，这是强非谐极性材料的最小模型。在中等耦合下，迁移率表现出与一口井内的限制、与势垒的热竞争以及势垒不敏感的高温动力学相关的三种温度状态。该序列产生了迁移率的凹温度依赖性，这在传统的线性耦合极化子模型中是不存在的。在强耦合下，迁移率变得非单调，其温度演变反映在光谱权重的特征重新分布中。对于与 SrTiO$_3$ 相关的参数，我们的结果定性地再现了反常凹迁移率和违反 Mott-Ioffe-Regel 极限的开始，从而支持与软非谐晶格模式的非线性耦合作为稀极性金属中反常输运的微观机制。

title: Cell Natural Orbitals in Interacting Topological Bands
abstract: Topological bands exhibit obstruction to exponentially localized and symmetric Wannier functions, challenging the standard paradigm of representing projected interactions in terms of local orbitals with finite range. To faithfully capture the form factors and quantum geometry of topological bands we introduce a singular-value decomposition of the band-projected density form factors, enabling a geometry-based truncation scheme of the Hilbert space, exposing an intrinsic hierarchy on band-projected interactions that is determined by the underlying wavefunctions. This decomposition is most naturally described in terms of Cell Natural Orbitals (CNOs), as the eigenstates of the unit-cell reduced one-particle density matrix, whose occupation provide a measure of the minimal orbital complexity required to faithfully represent the band wavefunctions overlaps. The CNO decomposition identifies systematically the minimal number of local orbitals needed to reproduce short-ranged interactions while resolving the hierarchy of interaction strengths across CNO channels. Applied to magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene in the chiral limit, we find that the dominant CNO is centered at the AA site, resembling the $f$-fermion of the heavy-fermion model. The subdominant CNO channels carry progressively weaker interaction matrix elements, allowing them to be treated at the static mean-field level, while the dominant channel requires a dynamical self-energy. The formalism illustrates how variations of charge density within the unit cell generate momentum dependence in the CNO envelope function and, consequently, dispersion in the single-particle spectral function. More broadly, our results establish CNOs as a geometry-informed bridge between band topology and real-space correlations, providing a systematic framework for analyzing interactions and emergent phases in quantum materials.
summary:
拓扑带表现出对指数局域和对称 Wannier 函数的阻碍，挑战了用有限范围的局域轨道表示投影相互作用的标准范式。为了忠实地捕获拓扑带的形状因子和量子几何，我们引入了带投影密度形状因子的奇异值分解，从而实现了希尔伯特空间的基于几何的截断方案，揭示了由底层波函数确定的带投影相互作用的内在层次结构。这种分解最自然地用细胞自然轨道（CNO）来描述，因为单位细胞的本征态减少了单粒子密度矩阵，其占用提供了忠实表示带波函数重叠所需的最小轨道复杂性的度量。 CNO 分解系统地识别了重现短程相互作用所需的最小局部轨道数量，同时解析了跨 CNO 通道的相互作用强度的层次结构。

应用于手性极限下的魔角扭曲双层石墨烯，我们发现主要的 CNO 集中在 AA 位点，类似于重费米子模型的 $f$-费米子。次主导的 CNO 通道携带逐渐减弱的相互作用矩阵元素，允许它们在静态平均场水平上进行处理，而主导通道则需要动态自能。该形式说明了晶胞内电荷密度的变化如何在 CNO 包络函数中产生动量依赖性，从而在单粒子谱函数中产生色散。更广泛地说，我们的结果将 CNO 确立为能带拓扑和实空间相关性之间的几何信息桥梁，为分析量子材料中的相互作用和涌现相提供了系统框架。

title: Celestial Holography, A Hitchhiker's Guide to the Celestial Sphere
abstract: This primer offers an first introduction to Celestial Holography, a rapidly evolving framework aiming to describe quantum gravity in asymptotically flat spacetimes. We start from the established foundation of the AdS/CFT correspondence before venturing into the wilds of Minkowski space. The journey covers the essential Bondi-Sachs formalism and the geometry of null infinity ($\mathscr{I}^\pm$), the discovery of the infinite-dimensional BMS asymptotic symmetry group. We explain the core holographic map given by Mellin transform that recasts four-dimensional scattering amplitudes as correlation functions of a conjectured 2D Celestial Conformal Field Theory (CCFT) on the celestial sphere. The presentation is made intuitive but the mathematics is still precise (hopefully!). It is designed to equip newcomers with both the conceptual landscape and the technical vocabulary to explore this exciting frontier.
summary: 本入门书首次介绍了天体全息术，这是一个快速发展的框架，旨在描述渐近平坦时空中的量子引力。在冒险进入 Minkowski 空间的荒野之前，我们从 AdS/CFT 通信的既定基础开始。该旅程涵盖了基本的 Bondi-Sachs 形式主义和零无穷大几何 ($\mathscr{I}^\pm$)，以及无限维 BMS 渐近对称群的发现。我们解释了梅林变换给出的核心全息图，该变换将四维散射振幅重新塑造为天球上推测的二维天体共形场论（CCFT）的相关函数。演示很直观，但数学仍然很精确（希望如此！）。它旨在为新手提供概念景观和技术词汇，以探索这一令人兴奋的前沿领域。

title: Three-loop onset of the wormhole length in DSSYK
abstract: The length of the Einstein-Rosen bridge in sine-dilaton gravity at disk level equals the Krylov spread complexity of the dual double-scaled SYK (DSSYK) model, with the double-scaling parameter $\lambda$ controlling the semiclassical expansion. We compute the onset value, $L_{0}$, in the thermofield double state at $t=0$ and arbitrary inverse temperature $\beta$, through three loops and in closed form, extending the known one-loop result. The quantity $L_{0}$ represents the preparation complexity of the initial thermal Hartle-Hawking state. In DSSYK, $L_{0}$ is $\lambda$ times the average chord number of the thermal state, providing a microscopic, unambiguous determination of an additive constant otherwise fixed only by a choice of holographic renormalization scheme. The two-loop contribution follows from a saddle point evaluation of the DSSYK two-point function at coincident insertion points, where individually divergent contributions cancel only in their sum. At three loops, we bypass the saddle point analysis using an exact recursion relation that generates long high-temperature expansions at low cost, fixing and testing a proposed Ansatz against many independent data points. Finally, in the low-temperature regime each loop order contributes one further power of $\beta$, reorganizing the semiclassical series into an expansion in the Schwarzian coupling $\lambda\beta$, whose leading coefficient we check against an independent one-loop Schwarzian computation. The same methods, applied to the length variance and third-order cumulant at $t=0$, give their semiclassical expansion through two loops.
summary:
盘级正弦膨胀引力中爱因斯坦-罗森桥的长度等于对偶双尺度 SYK (DSSYK) 模型的 Krylov 展开复杂度，其中双尺度参数 $\lambda$ 控制半经典展开。我们通过三个循环并以闭合形式计算 $t=0$ 处热场双态和任意逆温度 $\beta$ 下的起始值 $L_{0}$，扩展了已知的单循环结果。数量 $L_{0}$ 表示初始热 Hartle-Hawking 状态的制备复杂性。在 DSSYK 中，$L_{0}$ 是 $\lambda$ 乘以热状态的平均弦数，提供了对加性常数的微观、明确的确定，否则只能通过选择全息重整化方案来固定。双环贡献源自 DSSYK 两点函数在重合插入点处的鞍点评估，其中单独不同的贡献仅在其总和中抵消。在三个循环中，我们使用精确的递归关系绕过鞍点分析，以低成本生成长时间的高温膨胀，针对许多独立的数据点修复和测试拟议的 Ansatz。

最后，在低温状态下，每个循环阶数进一步贡献 $\beta$ 的幂，将半经典级数重新组织为 Schwarzian 耦合 $\lambda\beta$ 的展开式，我们根据独立的单循环 Schwarzian 计算检查其主导系数。将相同的方法应用于 $t=0$ 时的长度方差和三阶累积量，通过两个循环给出它们的半经典展开式。

title: Towards a Holographic dual of Carrollian BCFT
abstract: In this work we aim to lay the foundation of flat version of AdS$_3$/BCFT$_2$ correspondence through Carrollian framework. We begin with discussing the recently discovered Boundary Carrollian Conformal Algebra (BCCA), the symmetry algebra of Carrollian BCFT. We identify this algebra at the null infinity of flat spacetime with appropriate choice of the end-of-the-world (EOW) brane. The properties of this EOW brane have been analysed both intrinsically and by taking flat limit from its AdS counterpart. We also find that the global as well as asymptotic symmetries of flat spacetime restricted by this EOW brane coincide exactly with the symmetries of BCCA.
summary: 在这项工作中，我们的目标是通过 Carrollian 框架为 AdS$_3$/BCFT$_2$ 通信的扁平化版本奠定基础。我们首先讨论最近发现的边界卡罗尔共形代数（BCCA），即卡罗尔 BCFT 的对称代数。我们通过适当选择世界末日（EOW）膜，在平坦时空的零无穷大处识别了这个代数。该 EOW 膜的属性已从本质上进行了分析，并通过从其 AdS 对应物中获取平坦限制来进行分析。我们还发现，受此 EOW 膜限制的平坦时空的全局对称性和渐近对称性与 BCCA 的对称性完全一致。

title: Superconformal indices and black hole saddles
abstract: The AdS/CFT correspondence implies that the superconformal index ${\mathcal I}$ in ${\mathcal N=4}$ SU(N) supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory can be computed using the dual bulk theory. In particular, in the limit of large $N$, the index should be given by a sum over appropriate saddles. However, ${\mathcal I}$ depends on potentials $\sigma, \tau, \vec \Delta$ and, at large ${\rm Im}\, \tau = {\rm Im}\, \sigma$, the CFT index ${\mathcal I}$ rapidly approaches $1$ at all values of $N$. As a result, black hole saddles associated with exponentially large contributions in $N$ cannot contribute in this limit. This in particular excludes saddles that were previously suggested to be relevant in such regimes. We thus consider an approach to the bulk path integral motivated by taking it to be defined as an integral over real Lorentz-signature spacetimes with codimension-2 singularities. This approach leads only to saddles that satisfy the above bound, and to the enforcement of this bound via Stokes phenomena. We also find similar results for bulk AdS$_4$ calculations of the ABJM superconformal index.
summary: AdS/CFT 对应意味着 ${\mathcal N=4}$ SU(N) 超对称 Yang-Mills 理论中的超共形指数 ${\mathcal I}$ 可以使用对偶体理论计算。特别是，在大$N$的限制下，索引应该由适当鞍点的总和给出。然而，${\mathcal I}$ 取决于势 $\sigma、\tau、\vec \Delta$，并且在大的情况下 ${\rm Im}\、\tau = {\rm Im}\、\sigma$，CFT 指数 ${\mathcal I}$ 在 $N$ 的所有值处快速接近 $1$。因此，与 $N$ 的指数级大贡献相关的黑洞鞍不能在此限制内做出贡献。这尤其排除了之前建议与此类制度相关的鞍座。因此，我们考虑一种体路径积分的方法，其动机是将其定义为具有余维 2 奇点的真实洛伦兹签名时空上的积分。这种方法仅导致满足上述界限的鞍座，并通过斯托克斯现象强制执行该界限。我们还发现 ABJM 超共形索引的批量 AdS$_4$ 计算有类似的结果。

title: R7-branes and AdS$_{\text{9}}$ solutions in type IIB
abstract: We consider the recently found $\mathrm{AdS}_9$ backgrounds in type IIB supergravity. We start by reviewing the solutions in a more convenient set of coordinates, which allows us to explicitly compute a few relevant observables, including the holographic central charge. Subsequently, we study non-supersymmetric 7-brane configurations sourced by the IIB axio-dilaton. We find explicit analytic 7-brane solutions that possess the above $\mathrm{AdS}_9$ backgrounds as their near-horizon geometry. Finally, we discuss the relation of these 7-brane solutions to the R7 branes by imposing the reflection monodromy $\tau \rightarrow -\bar \tau$ in the transverse plane.
summary: 我们考虑最近发现的 IIB 型超重力背景 $\mathrm{AdS}_9$。我们首先在一组更方便的坐标中检查解决方案，这使我们能够明确计算一些相关的可观察量，包括全息中心电荷。随后，我们研究了由 IIB 轴膨胀产生的非超对称 7 膜构型。我们找到了具有上述 $\mathrm{AdS}_9$ 背景作为其近地平线几何结构的显式解析 7 膜解。最后，我们通过在横向平面上施加反射单向性 $\tau \rightarrow -\bar \tau$ 来讨论这些 7 膜解与 R7 膜的关系。

title: Updates on Calabi-Yau manifolds from pairs of non-compact Calabi-Yau manifolds
abstract: We discuss developments in the construction of Calabi--Yau manifolds by smoothing normal crossing unions of quasi-Fano manifolds, following the introduction of this method to the physics community in 2010. We describe constructions of Calabi--Yau threefolds with unbounded second Betti numbers and with very small Hodge numbers, as well as the first non-Kähler examples in dimensions greater than three. The role of Landau--Ginzburg models in mirror constructions is also explained.
summary: 继 2010 年将该方法引入物理学界之后，我们讨论了通过平滑拟法诺流形的法向交叉并来构造 Calabi-Yau 流形的进展。我们描述了具有无界第二 Betti 数和非常小的 Hodge 数的 Calabi-Yau 三重构造，以及维度大于三的第一个非 Kähler 示例。还解释了朗道-金兹堡模型在镜子结构中的作用。

title: Supertranslations are Soft Dressings
abstract: Asymptotic states of massive particles in electrodynamics and gravity are not uniquely defined because of the absence of a mass gap. Working in the KMOC formalism, we study the classical implications of this freedom in the dressing of massive particle states. We show that coherent-state dressings modify observables by a large gauge/BMS transformation. The associated coherent-state displacement operator can be completed into a conserved charge, the BMS charge in the gravitational case, which implements large gauge transformations on scattering data. The parameter of our dressing is directly the large gauge/BMS transformation parameter, and we explain that observables do not depend on monopolar and dipolar parts of the transformation parameter to all orders. Our construction is driven by soft factorization rather than by an underlying local symmetry, and we illustrate this by exhibiting the same structure in a scalar theory with no gauge symmetry. We explore the action of large gauge transformations on two-particle states for scalar, abelian gauge and graviton mediators, obtaining a universal shift of the impact parameter and clarifying the frame dependence of the radiated angular momentum vis à vis the frame-independence of the total angular momentum. The transformation connecting the canonical BMS frame, in which the Schwarzschild metric takes the Kerr-Schild form, to the intrinsic frame, in which it takes the De Donder form, illustrates these effects concretely.
summary:
由于不存在质量间隙，电动力学和重力中大质量粒子的渐近态没有唯一定义。在 KMOC 形式主义中，我们研究了这种自由在大质量粒子态修饰中的经典含义。我们证明相干态敷料通过大规格/BMS 变换来修改可观测值。相关的相干态位移算子可以完成为守恒电荷，即引力情况下的 BMS 电荷，它对散射数据实现大规范变换。我们的修整参数直接是大规格/BMS 变换参数，并且我们解释了可观测量不依赖于所有阶变换参数的单极和偶极部分。我们的构造是由软分解驱动的，而不是由潜在的局部对称性驱动的，并且我们通过在没有规范对称性的标量理论中展示相同的结构来说明这一点。

我们探索了标量、阿贝尔规范和引力子介体的大规范变换对双粒子态的作用，获得了冲击参数的通用位移，并澄清了辐射角动量的框架依赖性相对于总角动量的框架无关性。将规范 BMS 框架（其中 Schwarzschild 度量采用 Kerr-Schild 形式）与内在框架（其中采用 De Donder 形式）相连接的变换具体地说明了这些效应。

title: Bumpy horizons from non-linear sigma models
abstract: We show that black hole horizons with non-constant curvature can be constructed in any even dimension, when the source of the Einstein equations is given by the stress-energy tensor of a non-linear sigma model of a particular class
summary: 我们证明，当爱因斯坦方程的源由特定类别的非线性西格玛模型的应力-能量张量给出时，可以在任何偶数维度构建具有非恒定曲率的黑洞视界

title: Incidence Relations for Self-Dual Black Holes
abstract: In Penrose's nonlinear graviton construction, a self-dual spacetime arises as the moduli space of holomorphic twistor lines in curved twistor space, whose explicit parametrization is concretely given by the incidence relation. We demonstrate a concrete local construction of the incidence relations for self-dual black hole spacetimes in Kerr-Schild coordinates: Eguchi-Hanson, self-dual Taub-NUT, and self-dual Plebański-Demiański. This is facilitated by implementing the Dunajski-Mason recursion in the framework of Plebański's second heavenly equation, for which we explicitly find the Plebański scalar. Our results describe closed-form formulae. Notably, for the self-dual Taub-NUT solution, the exact incidence relation exhibits linear dependence on the gravitational coupling. The construction of zero-rest-mass fields on self-dual black hole backgrounds is briefly sketched as an application.
summary: 在彭罗斯的非线性引力子构造中，自对偶时空作为弯曲扭量空间中的全纯扭量线的模空间而出现，其显式参数化由重合关系具体给出。我们展示了 Kerr-Schild 坐标中自对偶黑洞时空重合关系的具体局部构造：Eguchi-Hanson、自对偶 Taub-NUT 和自对偶 Plebański-Demiański。这是通过在 Plebański 第二天堂方程的框架中实现 Dunajski-Mason 递归来实现的，我们明确地找到了 Plebański 标量。我们的结果描述了封闭式公式。值得注意的是，对于自对偶 Taub-NUT 解，精确的入射关系表现出对引力耦合的线性依赖性。简要概述了自对偶黑洞背景上零静止质量场的构造作为应用。

title: Four-Fermion Condensates in Curved Spacetimes: A Functional Approach
abstract: Four-fermion interactions appear in effective descriptions of particle physics, many-body systems, and gravitational theories with fermions. Although the same local operator may enter perturbative scattering, a vacuum Nambu-Jona-Lasinio (NJL) instability, or finite-density Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) pairing, these regimes are distinguished by their interaction channels, quadratic kernels, and quantum states. We give a pedagogical functional account of these distinctions and compute the local one-loop contribution of a scalar-channel NJL mean field to the energy-momentum tensor in curved spacetime. We first display the state data in the in-out functional and construct the closed-time-path functional required for an in-in expectation value. For the NJL saddle, a Hubbard-Stratonovich field shifts the fermion mass, and the parity-even Dirac determinant generates local volume, curvature, and curvature-squared operators. We find the covariant quantum effective action before specializing to a spatially flat FLRW background and derive the corresponding energy density and pressure. The constant-condensate limit agrees with the direct flat-space mean-field calculation. We also explain which additional state and channel data are required for finite-density BCS pairing and comment on renormalization conditions in curved spacetimes.
summary:
四费米子相互作用出现在粒子物理学、多体系统和费米子引力理论的有效描述中。尽管相同的局域算子可能会进入微扰散射、真空 Nambu-Jona-Lasinio (NJL) 不稳定性或有限密度 Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) 配对，但这些状态的区别在于它们的相互作用通道、二次核和量子态。我们给出了这些区别的教学函数解释，并计算了标量通道 NJL 平均场对弯曲时空能量动量张量的局部单环贡献。我们首先在输入输出函数中显示状态数据，并构造输入期望值所需的闭合时间路径函数。对于 NJL 鞍座，哈伯德-斯特拉托诺维奇场会移动费米子质量，奇偶偶数狄拉克行列式会生成局部体积、曲率和曲率平方算子。我们在专门研究空间平坦的 FLRW 背景之前找到了协变量子有效作用，并推导了相应的能量密度和压力。恒定凝聚极限与直接平坦空间平均场计算一致。

我们还解释了有限密度 BCS 配对需要哪些额外的状态和通道数据，并对弯曲时空的重整化条件进行了评论。

title: One gravity theory on the two-dimensional p-adic space and conjectures on $p$-adic AdS/CFT
abstract: By means of a higher-dimensional embedding approach, together with the study of distance, measure, and curvature, we construct a gravitational theory on the two-dimensional space over $p$-adic numbers. Before obtaining the final gravitational theory, we supplement some calculations based on existing literature and justify the reasonableness of the gravitational theory by comparison with the real-number case-for instance, the curvatures of de Sitter(dS), anti-de Sitter(AdS), and Euclidean spaces should be positive, negative, and zero, respectively. Finally, we put forward two conjectures: (1) $p$-adic AdS/CFT can be computed in arbitrary spaces, not only in $p$-adic AdS space($p$AdS), and the results are essentially the same; (2) $p$-adic CFT is essentially unique.
summary: 通过高维嵌入方法，结合距离、测度和曲率的研究，我们在 $p$-adic 数上构建了二维空间的引力理论。在得到最终的引力理论之前，我们在现有文献的基础上补充一些计算，并通过与实数情况的比较来证明引力理论的合理性——例如，德西特(dS)、反德西特(AdS)和欧几里得空间的曲率分别应为正、负和零。最后，我们提出两个猜想：（1）$p$-adic AdS/CFT 可以在任意空间中计算，而不仅仅是在 $p$-adic AdS 空间（$p$AdS）中计算，并且结果本质上是相同的； (2) $p$-adic CFT 本质上是独一无二的。

title: Gauge transformations in Z-space in (anti)holomorphic sector of HS theory
abstract: We consider a consistent deformation of the (anti)holomorphic generating system of [ arXiv:2209.01966 ], aiming to provide a map to the (anti)holomorphic truncation of the Vasiliev theory. In our new formulation, the previously rigidly defined master-field $\Lambda$ can be shifted by $\mathrm{d}_z$-exact projective one-forms. The class of projective one-forms is described comprehensively, and corresponding projective identities are proven. $\mathrm{d}_z$-exact forms of the order $n$ in $C$ induce field redefinition of order $(n+1)$ and beyond. Explicit expression for the $(n+1)$-th order field redefinitions are provided. An analysis of the gauge transformation of the second order in $C$ in zero-forms is performed, identifying necessary and sufficient conditions for the part of the field redefinition of the second order that can be gauged away. The field redefinitions induced by the shift of $\Lambda$ are proven to be nontrivial.
summary: 我们考虑[arXiv:2209.01966]的（反）全纯生成系统的一致变形，旨在为Vasiliev理论的（反）全纯截断提供映射。在我们的新公式中，先前严格定义的主域 $\Lambda$ 可以通过 $\mathrm{d}_z$ 精确射影一式进行移位。全面描述了射影一式类，并证明了相应的射影恒等式。 $\mathrm{d}_z$ - $C$ 中 $n$ 阶的精确形式导致 $(n+1)$ 阶及以上的域重新定义。提供了第 $(n+1)$ 阶字段重新定义的显式表达式。对零形式的 $C$ 中的二阶规范变换进行了分析，确定了二阶场重新定义中可以测量的部分的必要和充分条件。由 $\Lambda$ 的移位引起的字段重新定义被证明是不平凡的。

title: Complex CFTs: Holography and Interfaces
abstract: We investigate complex conformal field theories and interfaces between such theories, using methods of holography and two dimensional CFT. We use holography to prove the Im-flip property of complex conjugate CFTs. We construct a complex Janus solution and calculate some holographic observables. Complex RG-flow interfaces are obtained numerically. On the CFT side, complex interfaces are constructed for free boson CFTs with and without background charge. Boundary states are constructed, and transmission and reflection coefficients are calculated in both cases.
summary: 我们使用全息术和二维 CFT 方法研究复杂的共形场论以及这些理论之间的接口。我们使用全息术来证明复杂共轭 CFT 的 Im-flip 特性。我们构建了一个复杂的 Janus 解并计算了一些全息可观测量。通过数值方法获得了复杂的 RG 流接口。在 CFT 方面，为带或不带背景电荷的自由玻色子 CFT 构建了复杂的接口。在这两种情况下都构建了边界态，并计算了透射和反射系数。

title: Carrollian Quantum Mechanics: Time-like, Space-like and Hybrid Sectors
abstract: We develop a comprehensive theoretical framework for Carrollian quantum mechanics by performing systematic ultra-relativistic contractions of the Klein--Gordon equation in the limit $c \to 0$. This limiting process uncovers three distinct sectors---time-like, space-like, and hybrid---each governed by a Carroll-invariant wave equation and accompanied by a consistent probabilistic interpretation. The time-like sector exhibits a novel temporal tunneling phenomenon, characterized by the relation $|\mathcal{T}|^2 = 1 + |\mathcal{R}|^2$, which reflects the indefinite character of the Klein--Gordon norm. In the space-like sector, the presence of spatial propagation necessitates a tachyonic dispersion relation, which forces the density to vanish for energy eigenstates, yielding zero-norm (null) states that gain physical relevance within Carrollian physics due to the underlying null geometric structure. The hybrid sector combines features of both sectors and admits two distinct formulations, which may be either tachyonic or non-tachyonic, and can be interpreted as an inhomogeneous Klein--Gordon equation. For all three sectors, we derive the corresponding continuity equations, probability densities, and currents, and investigate canonical quantum systems---including the particle in a box and tunneling phenomena---within the Carrollian regime.
summary:
我们通过在$c \to 0$的极限内对克莱因-戈登方程进行系统的超相对论收缩，为卡罗尔量子力学开发了一个全面的理论框架。这个限制过程揭示了三个不同的部分——类时间、类空间和混合——每个部分都由卡罗尔不变波动方程控制，并伴随着一致的概率解释。类时间扇区表现出一种新颖的时间隧道现象，其特征为关系 $|\mathcal{T}|^2 = 1 + |\mathcal{R}|^2$，反映了克莱因-戈登范数的不确定特征。在类空间扇区中，空间传播的存在需要快子色散关系，这迫使能量本征态的密度消失，产生零范数（零）状态，由于底层的零几何结构，这些零范数（零）状态在卡罗尔物理学中获得了物理相关性。混合部分结合了两个部分的特征，并允许两种不同的公式，它们可以是快子方程或非快子方程，并且可以解释为非齐次克莱因-戈登方程。

对于所有三个部分，我们推导了相应的连续性方程、概率密度和电流，并研究了卡罗尔体系内的规范量子系统（包括盒子中的粒子和隧道现象）。

title: Organizing transitions and their cascades: Generalized symmetry enforcement in massless flows or Higgs transitions
abstract: We study the role of generalized symmetry in massless renormalization group flows or Higgs transitions. In particular, we revisit the massless renormalization group flows in unitary minimal models, $\mathbf{M}(p,p+1) \rightarrow \overline{\mathbf{M}(p-1,p)}$ preserving the fusion ring symmetry $\text{FR} (SU(2)_{p-2})\subset \mathbf{M}(p,p+1)$ where $p$ is an integer satisfying $p>3$. In this series of flows, we demonstrate that the unbroken fusion ring symmetry $\text{FR} (SU(2)_{p-2})$ eliminates all relevant perturbations in the $\overline{\mathbf{M}(p-1,p)}$ model. Hence, the infrared theory $\overline{\mathbf{M}(p-1,p)}$ is stable at the level of the scaling analysis and can be interpreted as a (weak-)symmetry-enforced gapless phase in contemporary theoretical physics. Phenomenologically, by the folding trick, the unbroken fusion ring symmetry corresponds to a (half-)integer spin nonsimple current, a variant of the Cooper pair involving nonabelian anyons generated from the coset or level-rank duality structures. Moreover, we demonstrate that the structure of (half-)integer spin nonsimple current plays a fundamental role in causing the resonance effect of relevant and dangerously irrelevant perturbations. This resonance effect may result in the cascade of phase transitions (or the system flows to unexplored fixed points), and the symmetry can be a stopper of such unconventional flows.
summary:
我们研究广义对称性在无质量重正化群流或希格斯跃迁中的作用。特别是，我们重新审视酉最小模型中的无质量重正化群流 $\mathbf{M}(p,p+1) \rightarrow \overline{\mathbf{M}(p-1,p)}$ 保留融合环对称性 $\text{FR} (SU(2)_{p-2})\subset \mathbf{M}(p,p+1)$ 其中 $p$ 是满足以下条件的整数$p>3$。在这一系列流程中，我们证明了不间断的融合环对称性 $\text{FR} (SU(2)_{p-2})$ 消除了 $\overline{\mathbf{M}(p-1,p)}$ 模型中的所有相关扰动。因此，红外理论 $\overline{\mathbf{M}(p-1,p)}$ 在标度分析层面上是稳定的，可以解释为当代理论物理学中的（弱）对称性强制无间隙相。在现象学上，通过折叠技巧，未破缺的聚变环对称性对应于（半）整数自旋非简单流，这是库珀对的变体，涉及从陪集或能级对偶结构生成的非交换任意子。

此外，我们证明（半）整数自旋非简单电流的结构在引起相关和危险的不相关扰动的共振效应中发挥着基础作用。这种共振效应可能会导致级联相变（或系统流向未探索的固定点），而对称性可能会阻止这种非常规流动。

title: Conformally mapping HKLL to flat space
abstract: We study two conformal images of the HKLL reconstruction problem for a conformally coupled scalar on AdS$_3$. The first mapping is to a Dirichlet problem on one half of the Einstein static universe. A further conformal transformation maps this half-ESU problem to a massless scalar in a region of $(2+1)$-dimensional Minkowski space bounded by an uniformly accelerated circular Dirichlet mirror. However, the global HKLL problem, the resulting flat-space problem is not a generic local mirror problem with arbitrary boundary data. Rather, the mirror response data must belong to a restricted spectral class inherited from normalizable global AdS modes. We formulate and solve this restricted mirror problem intrinsically in flat space. In the process, we find an example of a valid smearing function which itself does not satisfy the equations of motion. We further consider AdS-Rindler wedge reconstruction. By conformal mapping to an appropriate coordinate system in flat space, we find a simple way to see the blow-up of the smearing function.
summary: 我们研究了 AdS$_3$ 上共形耦合标量的 HKLL 重建问题的两个共形图像。第一个映射是爱因斯坦静态宇宙一半上的狄利克雷问题。进一步的共形变换将这个半 ESU 问题映射到由均匀加速的圆形狄利克雷镜界定的 $(2+1)$ 维 Minkowski 空间区域中的无质量标量。然而，全局 HKLL 问题（即由此产生的平坦空间问题）并不是具有任意边界数据的通用局部镜像问题。相反，镜像响应数据必须属于从可归一化的全局 AdS 模式继承的受限光谱类别。我们本质上在平坦空间中制定并解决了这个受限镜像问题。在此过程中，我们找到了一个有效的涂抹函数的示例，该函数本身并不满足运动方程。我们进一步考虑 AdS-Rindler 楔形重建。通过共形映射到平坦空间中适当的坐标系，我们找到了一种简单的方法来查看涂抹函数的放大。

title: Thermodynamic stability and geometric thermodynamics of charged black holes in Rastall-massive gravity under quintessence
abstract: In the present paper, we derive a new charged black hole solution embedded in a quintessence field within a framework combining the Rastall and massive gravity in an asymptotically flat spacetime. We interpret the integration constant associated with the structural properties of the quintessence field as a thermodynamical variable. In this context, several limiting cases have been explored with the aim to shed light on the role of the model parameters. Then, we analyse the thermodynamic properties and stability of the charged black holes in flat spacetime, where the quintessence field is characterized by the state parameter \( \omega_q = -2/3 \). Detailed studies are perfomed to see how the various parameters affect phase transitions between small and large black holes. In particular, we establish a connection between the impact parameter and unstable circular photon orbits with the thermodynamic phase transitions. Our analysis suggest that the photon sphere observables could remarkably provide an indirect observational signature of black hole thermodynamic critical transitions. Generally, thanks to the effective contribution of the quintessence parameter, we found that the overall thermodynamic behavior basically resembles that of the charged RN--AdS black hole with thermal features analogous to of a Van der Waals fluid ones. Finally, we have checked these findings using thermodynamic geometry with the Quevedo metric. Our results showed that the critical behaviour derived from the standard thermodynamics is fully consistent with geothermodynamics description, where the phase structure and divergence points exactly coincide with those identified from heat capacity and Gibbs free energy analyses.
summary:
在本文中，我们推导了一种新的带电黑洞解决方案，该解决方案嵌入在渐进平坦时空中结合拉斯托尔和大质量引力的框架内的精髓场中。我们将与精华场的结构特性相关的积分常数解释为热力学变量。在这种情况下，我们探讨了几种限制情况，旨在阐明模型参数的作用。然后，我们分析了平坦时空中带电黑洞的热力学性质和稳定性，其中本质场由状态参数\(\omega_q = -2/3 \)来表征。进行了详细的研究，以了解各种参数如何影响小黑洞和大黑洞之间的相变。特别是，我们在冲击参数和不稳定圆形光子轨道与热力学相变之间建立了联系。我们的分析表明，光子球可观测值可以显着提供黑洞热力学临界转变的间接观测特征。

总体而言，由于本质参数的有效贡献，我们发现整体热力学行为基本上类似于带电RN-AdS黑洞，其热特征类似于范德华流体黑洞。最后，我们使用热力学几何和 Quevedo 度量检验了这些发现。我们的结果表明，标准热力学得出的临界行为与地热力学描述完全一致，其中相结构和发散点与热容和吉布斯自由能分析确定的相结构和发散点完全一致。

title: An explicit four-corner dictionary for (2,p) minimal Liouville gravity
abstract: (2,p) minimal Liouville gravity admits four algebraic descriptions interrelated by dualities. On the Frobenius manifold (FM) side the theory is built either on the $A_{1}$ manifold of $Q(y)=y^{2}+u_{1}$ ($y$-side) or on the $A_{p-1}$ manifold in the variable $x$ ($x$-side). On the spectral curve / topological recursion (SC) side the analogous choice is the Chebyshev curve and its $x \leftrightarrow y$ swap. FM-$y$, SC-$y$ require a resonance transformation between the KdV times and the Liouville couplings, while the other two do not. We work out the explicit correspondence between the four approaches at the level of the dispersionless tau-function. The normalisation-independent three-point ratios agree with conformal field theory in all four formulations, and matching the full amplitudes fixes a single per-insertion factor reproducing the signed Verlinde matrices. The $x \leftrightarrow y$ swap relating the two spectral curve descriptions, recently established in general by Dekinga, Shadrin and Verlinde, is realised at genus zero as a tree-level frame change of the generalised Kontsevich integral transform with potential $\Phi^{p}/p$. The derivation is validated across (2,5)--(2,11) models.
summary:
(2,p) 最小刘维尔引力允许四个通过对偶性相互关联的代数描述。在弗罗贝尼乌斯流形 (FM) 方面，该理论要么建立在 $Q(y)=y^{2}+u_{1}$（$y$ 侧）的 $A_{1}$ 流形上，要么建立在变量 $x$（$x$ 侧）的 $A_{p-1}$ 流形上。在谱曲线/拓扑递归（SC）方面，类似的选择是切比雪夫曲线及其 $x \leftrightarrow y$ 交换。 FM-$y$、SC-$y$ 需要 KdV 时间和刘维尔耦合之间的共振变换，而其他两个则不需要。我们在无色散 tau 函数层面上计算出了四种方法之间的明确对应关系。与归一化无关的三点比率与所有四种公式中的共形场理论一致，并且匹配全振幅修复了再现带符号的 Verlinde 矩阵的单个每个插入因子。与两个光谱曲线描述相关的 $x \leftrightarrow y$ 交换，最近由 Dekinga、Shadrin 和 Verlinde 一般建立，在属零处实现为具有潜在 $\Phi^{p}/p$ 的广义 Kontsevich 积分变换的树级框架变化。

该推导在 (2,5)--(2,11) 模型中得到验证。

title: The explicit Lorentz invariant QED pair production rates from superstrings
abstract: We present a new avenue to the usual Schwinger effect via the open string pair production for a system of two Dp branes with $1 \le p \le 6$ in Type II superstrings. The two Dp are placed parallel at a separation with one of them carrying the most general constant electromagnetic background allowed for the pair production. By taking the so-called field theory limit, we obtain systematically, from the open string pair production rate, the respective \textit{explicit Lorentz invariant} QED pair production rate in diverse dimensions for a pair of charged/anti-charged massive particles, which can be scalars, spinors or vectors.
summary: 我们通过为两个 Dp 膜系统（在 II 型超弦中具有 $1 \le p \le 6$ 的开弦对产生）提供了一种实现通常施温格效应的新途径。两个 Dp 以一定间隔平行放置，其中一个具有允许配对产生的最常见的恒定电磁背景。通过采用所谓的场论极限，我们从开弦对产生速率系统地获得了一对带电/反带电大质量粒子（可以是标量、旋量或矢量）在不同维度上各自的 \textit{显式洛伦兹不变量} QED 对产生速率。

title: Understanding Non-Split 2-Group Symmetry: (3+1)D SymTFT, Anomaly and Bordism
abstract: We present a systematic study of finite, non-split 2-group symmetries with a non-trivial Postnikov class, focusing on the simplest example with a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 0-form symmetry and a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 1-form symmetry, intertwined together by the non-trivial Postnikov class in $H^3(B\mathbb{Z}_2;\mathbb{Z}_2)\cong\mathbb{Z}_2$, denoted by $\mathcal{G}$. We classify the anomalies of this 2-group symmetry for physical theories in $d$-dimensional spacetime, by computing the oriented bordism groups $\Omega_{d+1}^{\rm SO}(B\mathcal{G})$ and the spin bordism groups $\Omega_{d+1}^{\rm Spin}(B\mathcal{G})$ for $d\leq 5$. For the case of $d=3$, we investigate the Symmetry TFT/TO of the 2-group symmetry $\mathcal{G}$ using the language of fusion 2-categories, as well as (3+1)D TQFT actions, for the cases without or with the 2-group anomaly classified by $\operatorname{Hom}\left(\widetilde{\Omega}_4^{\rm SO}(B\mathcal{G}),U(1)\right) \cong H^4(B\mathcal{G};U(1))\cong\mathbb{Z}_2$. We classify the minimal topological and physical boundary conditions of the Symmetry TFTs, and carry out the categorical Landau paradigm for such non-split finite 2-group.
summary: 我们提出了对非平凡 Postnikov 类的有限非分裂 2 群对称性的系统研究，重点关注最简单的例子，即 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 0 型对称性和 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 1 型对称性，它们由非平凡 Postnikov 类交织在一起$H^3(B\mathbb{Z}_2;\mathbb{Z}_2)\cong\mathbb{Z}_2$，用$\mathcal{G}$表示。我们通过计算$d\leq 5$的定向棱柱群$\Omega_{d+1}^{\rm SO}(B\mathcal{G})$和自旋棱柱群$\Omega_{d+1}^{\rm Spin}(B\mathcal{G})$，对$d$维时空中物理理论的二群对称性的异常进行分类。对于 $d=3$ 的情况，我们使用融合 2 类别语言以及 (3+1)D TQFT 操作来研究 2 组对称性 $\mathcal{G}$ 的对称 TFT/TO，对于没有或有由 $\operatorname{Hom}\left(\widetilde{\Omega}_4^{\rm 分类的 2 组异常的情况) SO}(B\mathcal{G}),U(1)\right)\cong H^4(B\mathcal{G};U(1))\cong\mathbb{Z}_2$。我们对对称 TFT 的最小拓扑和物理边界条件进行分类，并对这种非分裂有限 2 群执行分类 Landau 范式。

title: 3d $\mathcal N=4$ rank-zero mirror symmetry, TQFT interfaces, and Zagier duality of Nahm sums
abstract: Starting from the $(E_8,T_1)$ Nahm sum for the vacuum character of $T_{10}M_{\rm eff}(11,2)$, we construct a three-dimensional (3d) $\mathcal N=2$ $U(1)^8$ Chern--Simons matter theory $\mathcal T$ with level matrix $C_{E_8}$. Its $A$-twisted vacuum half-index reproduces the character exactly, while four distinguished Wilson loop half-indices agree with the remaining characters to the orders checked. Applying particle--vortex duality and gauging yields a second 3d $\mathcal N=2$ Chern--Simons matter theory $\mathcal T^\vee$ with level matrix $C_{E_8}^{-1}$. Exact superconformal-index matching supports the claim that the two theories flow to 3d $\mathcal N=4$ rank-zero mirror SCFTs. For the $(\mathcal D,D_c)$ boundary condition, the mirror map between the $A$-twisted Wilson loop half-indices of $\mathcal T$ and the $B$-twisted Wilson loop half-indices of $\mathcal T^\vee$ coincides componentwise with the Zagier transformation, realizing a Zagier duality between the complete $(E_8,T_1)$ and $(T_1,E_8)$ Nahm systems. Using the Bethe-equation formalism, we show that the corresponding $A/B$-twisted TQFT data agree up to orientation reversal and the $E_8$ framing phase $e^{-2\pi \mathrm{i}/3}$. The duality interface gives the torus bilinear $Z_{\mathcal I}(\tau)=\sum_i\chi_i(\tau)\chi_i^\vee(\tau)=\chi_{(E_8)_1}(\tau)$, where $\{\chi_i\}$ and $\{\chi_i^\vee\}$ are the corresponding five-component character bases. Thus Zagier duality is realized as part of a concrete 3d mirror and interface structure.
summary:
从 $T_{10}M_{\rm eff}(11,2)$ 的真空特性的 $(E_8,T_1)$ Nahm 和开始，我们构建了一个三维 (3d) $\mathcal N=2$ $U(1)^8$ Chern--Simons 物质理论 $\mathcal T$ 和水平矩阵 $C_{E_8}$。它的$A$扭曲真空半索引精确地再现了该字符，而四个杰出的威尔逊循环半索引与所检查的命令的剩余字符一致。应用粒子-涡旋二元性和测量产生第二个 3d $\mathcal N=2$ Chern--Simons 物质理论 $\mathcal T^\vee$ 和水平矩阵 $C_{E_8}^{-1}$。精确的超共形索引匹配支持这两种理论流向 3d $\mathcal N=4$ 零秩镜像 SCFT 的说法。对于$(\mathcal D,D_c)$边界条件，$\mathcal T$的$A$扭曲威尔逊环半指数与$\mathcal T^\vee$的$B$扭曲威尔逊环半指数之间的镜像映射与Zagier变换分量一致，实现了完整的$(E_8,T_1)$和$(T_1,E_8)$之间的Zagier对偶性纳姆系统。

使用 Bethe 方程形式，我们表明相应的 $A/B$ 扭曲 TQFT 数据符合方向反转和 $E_8$ 成帧阶段 $e^{-2\pi \mathrm{i}/3}$。对偶接口给出环面双线性 $Z_{\mathcal I}(\tau)=\sum_i\chi_i(\tau)\chi_i^\vee(\tau)=\chi_{(E_8)_1}(\tau)$，其中 $\{\chi_i\}$ 和 $\{\chi_i^\vee\}$ 是相应的五分量字符库。因此，扎吉尔对偶性被实现为具体 3D 镜子和界面结构的一部分。

title: Running soft theorems in effective field theory
abstract: We study soft theorems for photons and pions with local effective field theory (EFT) corrections up to one loop order. In massive QED with a dimension-five Pauli operator, the local analytic part of the subleading soft photon theorem is renormalized by the hard integration region. On the other hand, as was previously known, the logarithmic soft terms do not receive corrections from higher-dimensional operators. We find that analogous structure appears in the double-soft pion theorem: the coefficients of logarithmic contributions are controlled entirely by the Nonlinear Sigma Model (NLSM) Lagrangian, while the Wilson coefficients of four-derivative operators in Chiral EFT appear in local subleading terms, in a form that is dictated by their RG equations.
summary: 我们研究光子和π介子的软定理，并使用局域有效场论（EFT）校正高达一环阶。在具有五维泡利算子的大规模 QED 中，次领先软光子定理的局部解析部分由硬积分区域重新规范化。另一方面，如先前所知，对数软项不接受来自高维算子的修正。我们发现类似的结构出现在双软π介子定理中：对数贡献的系数完全由非线性西格玛模型（NLSM）拉格朗日控制，而手性EFT中四导数算子的威尔逊系数出现在局部副首项中，其形式由其RG方程决定。

title: Holography in flipped AdS/$\mathbb{Z}$: Another approach to dS holography
abstract: Motivated by the subtleties in the conventional dS/CFT correspondence, we explore analytic continuation as a constructive route to de Sitter holography. We show that quantum field theories in de Sitter space and in a spacetime that we call flipped $\mathrm{AdS}/\mathbb{Z}$ (fAdS) are related by analytic continuation. We then develop a holographic description of fAdS in terms of a boundary theory referred to as flipped CFT (fCFT). In particular, we construct the extrapolate dictionary for general asymptotically fAdS spacetimes and compute the holographic two-point functions, finding agreement with an independent derivation based on the conformal symmetry of fCFT. The analytic continuation relation between fAdS and dS further suggests that fCFT may provide a starting point for an alternative holographic description of de Sitter physics. As a nontrivial check of this picture, we show that the Cardy formula of fCFT$_2$ reproduces the Bekenstein--Hawking entropies of the cosmological horizons in both pure dS$_3$ and Kerr-dS$_3$.
summary: 受传统 dS/CFT 对应关系中微妙之处的启发，我们探索解析延拓作为德西特全息术的建设性途径。我们证明德西特空间中的量子场论和我们称为翻转的时空 $\mathrm{AdS}/\mathbb{Z}$ (fAdS) 之间通过解析延拓相关。然后，我们根据称为翻转 CFT (fCFT) 的边界理论开发 fAdS 的全息描述。特别是，我们构建了一般渐近 fAdS 时空的外推字典并计算全息两点函数，与基于 fCFT 共形对称性的独立推导找到了一致。 fAdS 和 dS 之间的解析连续关系进一步表明，fCFT 可能为德西特物理的另一种全息描述提供起点。作为对这张图片的重要检查，我们表明 fCFT$_2$ 的卡迪公式再现了纯 dS$_3$ 和 Kerr-dS$_3$ 中宇宙视界的贝肯斯坦-霍金熵。

title: Numerical Study of Scalar Field Theory on the Fuzzy Onion
abstract: We study the behaviour of the scalar field theory on the fuzzy onion model -- a three-dimensional matrix model consisting of concentric fuzzy spheres of gradually increasing radii. We use a numerical method of Hamiltonian Monte Carlo simulations to study the phase structure of this theory. We identify the field phases, investigate and describe a phenomenon of dynamical phase transitions and attempt to reconstruct phase transition lines. We compare the results with the well-studied phase structure of the fuzzy sphere. Finally, we identify two boundaries on the phase transitions of the theory, a uniform phase boundary and a critical boundary between the disordered and non-uniform phase.
summary: 我们研究标量场理论在模糊洋葱模型上的行为——一种由半径逐渐增加的同心模糊球体组成的三维矩阵模型。我们使用哈密顿蒙特卡罗模拟的数值方法来研究该理论的相结构。我们识别场相，研究和描述动态相变现象，并尝试重建相变线。我们将结果与经过充分研究的模糊球相结构进行比较。最后，我们确定了理论相变的两个边界：均匀相边界和无序相与非均匀相之间的临界边界。

title: Production of Primordial Black Holes in the Double D3-Brane - anti-D3-Brane Inflation Model
abstract: A natural extension of the successful $D3$-${\bar D}3$-brane inflation model in string theory is one with two $D3$-${\bar D}3$-brane pairs, giving rise to a novel feature in string-theory. When the first pair annihilates, $D1$-strings and $F1$-strings are produced. Following the non-commutative geometric properties in string theory, it is shown by Myers that the presence of the $D3$-charge field strength of the remaining $D3$-${\bar D}3$-brane pair leads to the formation of dielectric $3$-branes -- neutral, finite-size bound states of $3$-branes with $D1$-strings. They behave as matter with little or no pressure. Spanning a wide range of masses, they seed primordial black holes in the early universe.
summary: 弦理论中成功的 $D3$-${\bar D}3$-膜膨胀模型的自然扩展是具有两个 $D3$-${\bar D}3$-膜对，从而产生了弦理论中的一个新颖特征。当第一对消灭时，会产生 $D1$ 字符串和 $F1$ 字符串。根据弦理论中的非交换几何性质，迈尔斯表明，剩余 $D3$-${\bar D}3$-膜对的 $D3$-电荷场强度的存在导致介电 $3$-膜的形成 - $3$-膜与 $D1$-弦的中性、有限尺寸束缚态。他们的行为就像物质一样，几乎没有压力。它们跨越了广泛的质量范围，在早期宇宙中播下了原始黑洞的种子。

title: Matrix Multiverses Meet Multiple Mythologies
abstract: We present a model in which asymptotically de Sitter universes of various types, and de Sitter (dS) radii $R_n$, live in the interiors of black holes in a maximally entropic flat $p = \rho$ Friedmann-Robertson-Walker universe. These dS universes clearly have many quantum states. We argue that they decay and equilibrate with the maximal entropy universe on time scales of order $\alpha_n R_n {\rm ln} (R_n /\delta_n)$, where $\alpha_n$ are model-dependent dimensionless constants and $\delta_n$ are the initial distances between the shell, satisfying the Israel junction conditions, and the dS horizon. These are time-scales as viewed by a detector following a trajectory far from the would-be cosmological horizon. These times are all exponentially shorter than dS recurrence times, which have no meaning in this model. It is impossible for a detector inside one of the dS universes to determine whether it is actually part of such a structure. This model could be used as the basis for claiming that certain constants of nature or cosmological initial conditions were chosen to have mathematically unnatural values because other values could not lead to any form of intelligent life.
summary: 我们提出了一个模型，其中各种类型的渐近德西特宇宙和德西特 (dS) 半径 $R_n$ 存在于最大熵平面 $p = \rho$ Friedmann-Robertson-Walker 宇宙中的黑洞内部。这些 dS 宇宙显然有许多量子态。我们认为它们在 $\alpha_n R_n {\rm ln} (R_n /\delta_n)$ 量级的时间尺度上与最大熵宇宙衰减和平衡，其中 $\alpha_n$ 是模型相关的无量纲常数，$\delta_n$ 是满足以色列结条件的壳与 dS 地平线之间的初始距离。这些是探测器所观察到的时间尺度，其轨迹远离可能的宇宙视界。这些时间都比 dS 重复时间指数短，在该模型中没有任何意义。 dS 宇宙中的探测器不可能确定它是否实际上是这种结构的一部分。该模型可以用作声称某些自然常数或宇宙学初始条件被选择具有数学上非自然值的基础，因为其他值不能导致任何形式的智能生命。

title: Superselected ghost theory: perturbation theory
abstract: A superselection rule based on an exact ghost parity can endow a ghost QFT with a probability interpretation. However, this ghost parity is not respected at finite order in the standard perturbative expansion. A ghost-parity-preserving perturbation theory (Z$_2$PT) is obtained through a similarity transformation of the Hamiltonian, $h=g H g^{-1}=h_0+h_1+h_2+...$. The resulting expansion is reminiscent of old-fashioned perturbation theory (OFPT) with some significant differences. The superselection rule selects the principal-value prescription for cross-sector energy denominators, with the prescription determined by the type of transition rather than the particle species. At third order, products of $h_1$ and $h_2$ combine with $h_3$ to reproduce OFPT away from vanishing denominators. At fourth order, when $h_1=0$, we show that $h_2^2$ and $h_4$ satisfy the analogous relation. Contact terms from vanishing denominators distinguish Z$_2$PT from OFPT but do not alter the local primitive UV divergences through these orders.
summary: 基于精确幽灵奇偶校验的超选择规则可以赋予幽灵 QFT 概率解释。然而，在标准微扰展开中，在有限阶上不遵守这种幽灵宇称。通过哈密顿量的相似变换$h=g H g^{-1}=h_0+h_1+h_2+...$得到鬼宇称保持微扰理论(Z$_2$PT)。由此产生的展开让人想起老式的微扰理论（OFPT），但有一些显着的差异。超选择规则为跨部门能量分母选择主值处方，该处方由过渡类型而不是粒子种类决定。在第三阶，$h_1$ 和 $h_2$ 的乘积与 $h_3$ 结合以重现 OFPT 远离消失的分母。在第四阶，当$h_1=0$时，我们证明$h_2^2$和$h_4$满足类似关系。来自消失分母的接触项将 Z$_2$PT 与 OFPT 区分开来，但不会通过这些顺序改变局部原始 UV 发散。

title: Long-range multipartite entanglement in holographic gapless systems
abstract: Gapless quantum systems support correlations over arbitrarily long distances, giving rise to power-law long-range entanglement. We investigate long-range entanglement at strong coupling for three-dimensional gapless systems using holography, asking whether multipartite entanglement can exhibit scale-growing behavior and become enhanced at large distances. We show that a broad class of multipartite entanglement quantities share the same leading large-distance scaling exponent determined by the IR geometry. To realize different scaling regimes, we consider hyperscaling-violating IR geometries. Depending on the parameters, long-distance multipartite entanglement can decay, become logarithmic, grow subextensively, or reach a volume law. We also analyze an anisotropic IR geometry \(\mathrm{AdS}_{3}\times\mathbb{R}^{2}\), where long-range multipartite entanglement survives along one direction but becomes short-ranged in the transverse gapped directions. These results show that holographic gapless phases can support rich and enhanced long-range multipartite entanglement, providing a nonlocal characterization of the underlying IR physics.
summary: 无间隙量子系统支持任意长距离的相关性，从而产生幂律长程纠缠。我们使用全息术研究了三维无间隙系统强耦合下的长程纠缠，询问多部分纠缠是否可以表现出尺度增长行为并在长距离处增强。我们证明了一大类多部分纠缠量共享由红外几何结构确定的相同的领先大距离标度指数。为了实现不同的缩放机制，我们考虑了违反 IR 的超缩放几何结构。根据参数的不同，长距离多部分纠缠可以衰减、变为对数、局部增长或达到体积定律。我们还分析了一种各向异性红外几何结构 \(\mathrm{AdS}_{3}\times\mathbb{R}^{2}\)，其中长程多部分纠缠沿一个方向存在，但在横向间隙方向上变为短程。这些结果表明，全息无间隙相可以支持丰富且增强的长程多部分纠缠，提供基础红外物理的非局域表征。

title: Holographic multipartite entanglement dynamics in AdS$_3$-Vaidya
abstract: We study how multipartite entanglement is dynamically reorganized during holographic thermalization following a global quench in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$. We first use the $n$-partite information $(-1)^n I_n$ to probe collective multipartite entanglement in holographic configurations where the full $n$-region entanglement wedge is connected while all fewer-party ones are disconnected, thereby excluding fewer-party contributions. The spatial range of multipartite entanglement first expands and then contracts as the system approaches its late-time locally thermal state. Entanglement involving different numbers of parties develops on comparable early-time scales, while the entanglement that involves more parties relaxes more slowly, revealing a transient propagation from shorter to longer spatial distances. We further compute the Markov gap and the genuine tripartite multi-entropy as complementary probes of tripartite entanglement. The Markov gap can remain enhanced after local thermalization, whereas the genuine tripartite multi-entropy undergoes a nonmonotonic evolution and returns to its vacuum value for the adjacent tripartition considered in this work. These results show that a global quench redistributes the entanglement across spatial scales and reorganizes its multipartite structure.
summary:
我们研究了在 AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ 中全局淬灭后的全息热化过程中多部分纠缠如何动态重组。我们首先使用 $n$ 部分信息 $(-1)^n I_n$ 来探测全息配置中的集体多部分纠缠，其中完整的 $n$ 区域纠缠楔形连接，而所有少方纠缠楔形都断开，从而排除少方贡献。当系统接近其后期局部热状态时，多部分纠缠的空间范围首先扩大，然后收缩。涉及不同数量参与方的纠缠在可比较的早期尺度上发展，而涉及更多参与方的纠缠松弛得更慢，揭示了从较短空间距离到较长空间距离的瞬态传播。我们进一步计算马尔可夫间隙和真正的三方多熵作为三方纠缠的互补探针。马尔可夫间隙在局部热化后仍然可以增强，而真正的三部分多熵经历非单调演化，并返回到本工作中考虑的相邻三部分的真空值。

这些结果表明，全局淬灭在空间尺度上重新分布纠缠并重新组织其多部分结构。

title: Nonperturbative Stabilization of D-Instantons in the Bosonic IIB Matrix Model
abstract: We study the bosonic type IIB (IKKT) matrix model and the fate of the D-instanton positions $p^{(i)}_\mu$, the diagonal components of the $d$ Hermitian matrices, whose one-loop effective potential infamously drives them to a single point. We argue that this collapse is an artifact of the leading (one-loop) truncation, while the actual non-collapse of the $p^{(i)}_\mu$ is a nonperturbative effect: it is invisible at one loop but already present in the exact (all-loop) two-body interaction. Since the two-body sector of the $N\times N$ model factorizes into copies of $N=2$, this interaction is captured exactly by the $\mathrm{U}(2)$ model, and we find that the two D-instantons do not collapse onto each other. To set up the computation, we gauge-fix the $\text{U}(N)$ symmetry in a way that keeps the diagonal and off-diagonal sectors distinct, and we handle the residual $\mathrm{U}(1)^N$ symmetry with an auxiliary-ghost BRST construction. This construction generates a new ghost four-leg vertex; the resulting Faddeev-Popov determinant admits a systematic large-separation expansion that organizes the effective potential into a many-body decomposition, separating the interaction into two-body, three-body, and higher-body contributions. The exact $N=2$ partition function is finite at finite separation; its naive Lorenz-gauge form develops a negative region at separations of order one, which we trace to a Gribov ambiguity of the Lorenz gauge and resolve with the maximal diagonal gauge--the classical frame containing the perturbative vacuum--where the short-distance force is finite and repulsive, so that the two-body potential develops a stable minimum at finite separation. These results are consistent with a stable, non-collapsed distribution of the $p^{(i)}_\mu$; establishing the detailed distribution and full $N$-body non-collapse requires the higher-body potentials and is left to future work.
summary:
我们研究了玻色子 IIB 型 (IKKT) 矩阵模型以及 D 瞬时位置 $p^{(i)}_\mu$（$d$ 埃尔米特矩阵的对角分量）的命运，其单环有效势将它们驱动到一个点。我们认为这种崩溃是前导（单循环）截断的产物，而 $p^{(i)}_\mu$ 的实际非崩溃是一种非微扰效应：它在一个循环中不可见，但已经存在于精确的（全循环）二体相互作用中。由于 $N\times N$ 模型的二体扇区分解为 $N=2$ 的副本，因此 $\mathrm{U}(2)$ 模型准确地捕获了这种相互作用，并且我们发现两个 D 瞬间不会相互塌陷。为了设置计算，我们以保持对角线和非对角线扇区不同的方式测量固定 $\text{U}(N)$ 对称性，并使用辅助鬼 BRST 结构处理剩余的 $\mathrm{U}(1)^N$ 对称性。

这种构造生成了一个新的幽灵四腿顶点；由此产生的 Faddeev-Popov 行列式承认系统性大分离扩展，将有效势组织为多体分解，将相互作用分为二体、三体和更高体贡献。精确的$N=2$配分函数在有限间隔处是有限的；它的朴素洛伦兹规范形式在一阶分离处形成一个负区域，我们将其追溯到洛伦兹规范的格里波夫模糊性，并用最大对角规范（包含微扰真空的经典框架）解决，其中短距离力是有限的和排斥的，因此二体势在有限分离处形成稳定的最小值。这些结果与 $p^{(i)}_\mu$ 的稳定、非塌陷分布一致；建立详细的分布和完整的 $N$ 体不崩溃需要较高体的潜力，并留待未来的工作。

title: Schwinger-Keldysh effective field theory of type-B Goldstone: near-diagonal geometry and Berry term
abstract: In this work, we formulate a finite temperature Schwinger-Keldysh effective field theory for type-B Goldstone modes. In particular, we organize the required two time contour structure by a near-diagonal geometry in which the r-type field is interpreted as the physical Goldstone configuration and the a-type field is identified as corresponding tangent displacement. Within this geometric viewpoint, the Berry term essential for type-B Goldstones is obtained directly through the transgression of the Berry curvature. Moreover, we show that this exact Berry transgression is compatible with dynamical KMS condition. In order to construct the conservative, dissipative and noise sectors, we classify possible tensors globally defined on the coset manifold. Based on this framework, we discuss in detail two concrete model examples. The dispersion relations of the Goldstone modes and the associated two-point correlation functions are calculated in the presence of dissipation.
summary: 在这项工作中，我们为 B 型 Goldstone 模式制定了有限温度 Schwinger-Keldysh 有效场理论。特别是，我们通过近对角线几何结构组织所需的二次轮廓结构，其中 r 型场被解释为物理戈德斯通配置，而 a 型场被识别为相应的切线位移。在这个几何观点中，B 型金石所必需的贝里项是通过贝里曲率的侵入直接获得的。此外，我们表明这种确切的 Berry 海侵与动态 KMS 条件兼容。为了构造保守扇区、耗散扇区和噪声扇区，我们对陪集流形上全局定义的可能张量进行分类。基于这个框架，我们详细讨论了两个具体的模型示例。戈德斯通模式的色散关系和相关的两点相关函数是在存在耗散的情况下计算的。

title: Thermal Origin of Black Hole Quasinormal Modes
abstract: When a black hole rings after a merger, it emits gravitational waves at characteristic frequencies known as quasinormal modes (QNMs). In the eikonal limit, these modes are governed by the unstable circular light orbits that form the photon ring. In this work, we demonstrate that the ringing of a black hole has a precise thermal interpretation. A probe string propagating in the near-ring geometry acquires an induced Rindler horizon on its worldsheet, with a temperature set by the Lyapunov exponent of the photon ring. Out of this structure, the black hole QNMs emerge as thermal excitations, so that the characteristic ringing of a black hole is the retarded response of a thermal system living on the photon ring. We explicitly derive the QNM spectrum from two complementary perspectives: microscopically, via unstable transverse worldsheet fluctuations, and macroscopically, through the pole structure of the causal response function of an open thermal quantum system.
summary: 当黑洞合并后响起时，它会以称为准正常模式（QNM）的特征频率发射引力波。在转角极限下，这些模式受形成光子环的不稳定圆形光轨道的控制。在这项工作中，我们证明了黑洞的振铃具有精确的热解释。在近环几何中传播的探测串在其世界片上获得诱导林德勒视界，其温度由光子环的李亚普诺夫指数设定。在这种结构中，黑洞 QNM 以热激发的形式出现，因此黑洞的特征振铃是光子环上热系统的延迟响应。我们从两个互补的角度明确地推导出 QNM 谱：微观上，通过不稳定的横向世界面涨落，宏观上，通过开放热量子系统的因果响应函数的极结构。

title: Closed-form thermal threshold functions for the proper-time renormalisation group
abstract: We derive closed-form expressions for the thermal threshold functions of the finite-temperature proper-time renormalisation group (PTRG): until now these have been evaluated numerically, Matsubara mode by Matsubara mode. For the standard one-parameter regulator family, Poisson resummation of the Matsubara sum yields a rapidly convergent winding-number series of modified Bessel functions, and a single algebraic identity reduces every higher threshold function to this same closed form at a shifted kernel parameter. The sharp proper-time regulator, recovered as the exact $m\to\infty$ endpoint of the family with a controlled $O(1/m)$ approach, factorises into a field-dependent and a purely thermal piece. Built on them, the local potential approximation (LPA) and its refinement to a running anomalous dimension (LPA$'$) for the $O(N)$-symmetric theory reduce to established results, all cross-checked against the exact Wetterich equation with the optimised regulator. Two findings go beyond reduction. First, the known zero-temperature anomalous-dimension construction is extended here to finite temperature. Second, because the closed form holds for any real regulator parameter, the refined truncation's fixed point can for the first time be tracked as a continuous function of the regulator, rather than at a handful of isolated points, and is found to vary smoothly and remain bounded, with no special or pathological point anywhere on the line.
summary:
我们推导了有限温度原时重正化群 (PTRG) 的热阈值函数的封闭式表达式：到目前为止，这些表达式已经通过松原模式逐个地进行了数值计算。对于标准的单参数调节器系列，松原和的泊松恢复产生了修正贝塞尔函数的快速收敛的绕数级数，并且单个代数恒等式将每个更高的阈值函数在移动的内核参数处减少到相同的闭合形式。尖锐的原时调节器，通过受控的 $O(1/m)$ 方法恢复为该系列的精确 $m\to\infty$ 端点，分解为一个依赖于场的纯热部件。在此基础上，$O(N)$ 对称理论的局部势近似 (LPA) 及其对运行反常维数 (LPA$'$) 的细化可简化为既定结果，所有这些都与具有优化调节器的精确 Wetterich 方程进行了交叉检查。有两个发现超出了减少的范围。首先，已知的零温度反常维度结构在这里扩展到有限温度。

其次，由于封闭形式适用于任何实际的调节器参数，因此精化截断的固定点第一次可以作为调节器的连续函数进行跟踪，而不是在几个孤立的点处，并且发现平滑变化并保持有界，在线上的任何地方都没有特殊或病态的点。

title: On the Renormalization in Conformal Quantum Gravity
abstract: One-loop divergences in classically conformal theory in curved spacetime is a nontrivial issue if the theory under consideration possesses gauge invariance. In this case, quantization involves introducing the gauge-fixing term and the action of ghosts, both of which are not conformal. The formal proof of the conformal invariant renormalizability in this situation, including interacting theories, has been given in the paper from 1984 by one of the present authors. Owing to BRST symmetry, the contributions of the gauge-fixing and ghost sectors to the conformal variation of the effective action cancel each other. This cancellation does not hold in the finite part of the one-loop and higher-loops effective action, that results in the anomaly. In this paper, we extend the early results on conformal matter fields in external gravitational field and apply them to conformal quantum gravity, including the case of conformal gravity coupled to other conformal matter fields. The gauge-fixing in the Weyl-squared gravity is more complicated, nevertheless, the proof of the one-loop conformal invariant renormalization using BRST symmetry is possible. As a preliminary to conformal quantum gravity, we also present a detailed general proof of conformal invariant one-loop divergences in the corresponding semiclassical theory.
summary:
如果所考虑的理论具有规范不变性，则弯曲时空中经典共形理论的单环发散是一个重要的问题。在这种情况下，量化涉及引入规范固定项和鬼影作用，这两者都是不共形的。本文作者之一在 1984 年的论文中给出了这种情况下的共形不变性重正化性的正式证明，包括相互作用的理论。由于 BRST 对称性，规范固定扇区和幻影扇区对有效作用的共形变化的贡献相互抵消。这种取消在单循环和更高循环有效动作的有限部分中不成立，从而导致异常。在本文中，我们扩展了外部引力场中共形物质场的早期结果，并将其应用于共形量子引力，包括共形引力与其他共形物质场耦合的情况。 Weyl 平方引力中的规范固定更为复杂，不过，使用 BRST 对称性证明单环保角不变重整化是可能的。

作为共形量子引力的初步研究，我们还提出了相应半经典理论中共形不变单环散度的详细一般证明。

title: Ricci-flat metrics from gauged linear $σ$-models without RG flow
abstract: We investigate a class of Ricci-flat Kähler metrics on generalized conifolds constructed via gauged linear sigma models (GLSMs) with indefinite signature. By introducing shadow coordinates (superfields) entering the sigma model with negative signature kinetic term, we show that these GLSMs yield explicit Ricci-flat metrics on complex cones over products of projective spaces. We provide a general formula for the resulting Kähler potentials, along with detailed examples. Our results suggest new directions for the study of Calabi-Yau metrics and toric geometry, and raise interesting questions about the geometric meaning of indefinite signature models. We also give an interpretation in terms of a novel generalized Kähler gauging.
summary: 我们研究了通过具有不定签名的计量线性 sigma 模型 (GLSM) 构建的广义锥折上的一类 Ricci-flat Kähler 度量。通过引入带有负签名动力学项的 sigma 模型的阴影坐标（超场），我们表明这些 GLSM 在射影空间乘积上的复杂锥体上产生显式的 Ricci 平坦度量。我们提供了所得凯勒势的通用公式以及详细的示例。我们的结果为卡拉比-丘度量和复曲面几何的研究提出了新的方向，并提出了关于不定签名模型的几何意义的有趣问题。我们还根据新颖的广义凯勒测量给出了解释。

title: The quadratic growth of Krylov spread complexity in the BTZ black hole
abstract: The boundary quantity that captures the growth of black-hole interiors quantified by holographic complexity remains unknown beyond 2d dilaton gravity. We provide a critical analysis of a partition-function construction of Krylov spread complexity for thermofield-double states that provides a dimension-independent boundary reconstruction from semiclassical holographic partition functions, while developing the present dynamical and bulk construction for the BTZ saddle. In the double-scaled Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model, where exact and semiclassical results can be compared, we show that the classical limit is reliable only when taken after the complexity has been reconstructed; taking this limit at the level of individual Lanczos coefficients discards essential information. Applying the construction to a large-central-charge two-dimensional conformal field theory above the Hawking-Page temperature dual to a Bañados-Teitelboim-Zanelli black hole, we find an intermediate departure from early-time quadratic growth followed by behavior compatible with a return toward asymptotically quadratic growth, rather than the linear late-time behavior of the volume and the standard finite-functional complexity = anything class. We then match this boundary behavior to a generalized complexity = anything bulk object built from an infinite series of extrinsic-curvature invariants. The construction provides a systematic route from black-hole thermodynamics to Krylov dynamics and can naturally be extended to higher-dimensional holographic black holes.
summary:
通过全息复杂性量化的捕获黑洞内部增长的边界量在二维膨胀引力之外仍然未知。我们对热场双态的 Krylov 扩展复杂性的配分函数结构进行了批判性分析，该结构提供了半经典全息配分函数的与维度无关的边界重建，同时开发了 BTZ 鞍座的当前动态和体结构。在双尺度 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型中，可以比较精确结果和半经典结果，我们表明经典极限仅在复杂性重建后才可靠；在各个 Lanczos 系数的水平上采用此限制会丢弃重要信息。

将其构造应用于Bañados-Teitelboim-Zanelli黑洞对偶霍金-佩奇温度以上的大中心电荷二维共形场理论，我们发现早期二次增长的中间偏离，随后的行为与渐近二次增长的回归兼容，而不是体积的线性后期行为和标准有限函数复杂性=任何类。然后，我们将这种边界行为与广义复杂性相匹配=任何由无限系列的外在曲率不变量构建的大块对象。该结构提供了从黑洞热力学到克雷洛夫动力学的系统路线，并且可以自然地扩展到更高维的全息黑洞。

title: Analytic Integration of the Lambert W Cosmic Fluid Model H(z) Formula
abstract: The Lambert $W$ (LW) model for the cosmic fluid equation of state was proposed by S. Saha and K. Bamba in 2019-2020. A recent (early 2026) paper by Dubey, et al, carries out a new fit of the LW model to observational data, in order to estimate the model's parameters. That paper exhibits a formula for the logarithm of the relative Hubble factor at redshift $z$, $\ln(H(z)/H_0)$, which is based upon a numerical integration. That integral can be evaluated analytically, and we present the details in this working paper. The resulting analytic expression for $H(z)/H_0$ may be convenient for exploration of the LW model.
summary: 宇宙流体状态方程的兰伯特 $W$ (LW) 模型是由 S. Saha 和 K. Bamba 在 2019-2020 年提出的。 Dubey 等人最近（2026 年初）发表的一篇论文对 LW 模型与观测数据进行了新的拟合，以估计模型的参数。该论文展示了红移 $z$ 处相对哈勃因子的对数公式，$\ln(H(z)/H_0)$，该公式基于数值积分。该积分可以通过分析方式进行评估，我们在本工作论文中介绍了详细信息。 $H(z)/H_0$ 的解析表达式可能有助于探索 LW 模型。

title: Perturbation Theory for Time-dependent Singular Quantum Systems
abstract: We develop a perturbative framework for time-dependent point interactions in quantum systems with purely discrete unperturbed spectrum. In two and three dimensions the point interaction is described through the renormalized resolvent obtained from heat-kernel regularization, while in one dimension the diagonal Green function is finite and no renormalization is required. Time dependence is introduced either through the interaction parameter or through the motion of the support point. In both cases we expand the non-autonomous Hamiltonian in the spectral basis of the corresponding static point-interaction problem and derive the first- and second-order pole shifts, projection corrections, and transition amplitudes. The method is illustrated by explicit examples: point interactions with time-dependent coupling, harmonic oscillators perturbed by moving point interactions, and a particle on a sphere with a moving interaction center. We also discuss the one-dimensional harmonic oscillator with a moving delta potential, showing that in the non-renormalized case the present formulation reduces to the standard time-dependent perturbation theory.
summary: 我们开发了一个微扰框架，用于具有纯离散未扰动光谱的量子系统中与时间相关的点相互作用。在二维和三维中，点相互作用是通过热核正则化获得的重整化解来描述的，而在一维中，对角格林函数是有限的，不需要重整化。时间依赖性是通过交互参数或支撑点的运动引入的。在这两种情况下，我们在相应的静态点相互作用问题的谱基础上扩展非自治哈密顿量，并推导出一阶和二阶极移、投影校正和跃迁幅度。该方法通过明确的示例进行说明：具有时间相关耦合的点相互作用、受移动点相互作用扰动的谐振子以及具有移动相互作用中心的球体上的粒子。我们还讨论了具有移动 Delta 势的一维谐振子，表明在非重整化情况下，当前公式简化为标准的瞬态微扰理论。

title: Moving Frames for Lie Pseudo-groups: A Recursive Implementation
abstract: A new recursive implementation of the equivariant moving frame method for infinite-dimensional Lie pseudo-group actions is presented. It allows pseudo-group normalizations to be performed before the prolonged action is computed, thereby avoiding the introduction of unnecessarily complicated intermediate expressions. Several examples are provided to illustrate the algorithm.
summary: 提出了一种新的用于无限维李伪群动作的等变移动框架方法的递归实现。它允许在计算延长动作之前执行伪群归一化，从而避免引入不必要的复杂中间表达式。提供了几个例子来说明该算法。

title: New results on the domain of analyticity of the free energy for the Ising model
abstract: We investigate the analyticity of the free energy of the Ising model in the presence of a non-zero external magnetic field, at high temperature, and at low temperature. Using the Fernandez--Procacci convergence criterion for cluster expansions, together with generating-function techniques and graph-theoretical methods, we derive improved convergence conditions in all three regimes. In particular, the generating-function approach yields sharper estimates for polymers and contours in the strong-field and low-temperature regimes, while a new high-temperature expansion based on Veblen's theorem provides a substantially larger analyticity region than the classical results in the literature.
summary: 我们研究了在非零外部磁场、高温和低温下伊辛模型自由能的解析性。使用集群扩展的 Fernandez-Procacci 收敛准则，结合生成函数技术和图论方法，我们在所有三种机制中推导了改进的收敛条件。特别是，生成函数方法在强场和低温条件下对聚合物和轮廓产生更清晰的估计，而基于维勃伦定理的新高温展开提供了比文献中的经典结果大得多的分析范围。

title: Notes on the Optical-Lattice Hard-Core Bose Gas of Aizenman--Lieb--Seiringer--Solovej--Yngvason
abstract: These are detailed expository notes on the staggered optical-lattice hard-core Bose gas of Aizenman, Lieb, Seiringer, Solovej and Yngvason. They restate and expand the arguments and their principal inputs in a common notation, and describe the central and orbitwise decompositions of thermodynamic-limit equilibrium states. The purpose is to make compressed or delegated steps explicit, not to introduce a new method, strengthen the estimates, or otherwise improve the cited results.
summary: 这些是关于 Aizenman、Lieb、Seiringer、Solovej 和 Yngvason 的交错光学晶格硬核玻色气体的详细说明。他们以通用符号重申和扩展了论点及其主要输入，并描述了热力学极限平衡态的中心和轨道分解。目的是使压缩或委托的步骤明确，而不是引入新方法、加强估计或以其他方式改进引用的结果。

title: The $\mathcal{L}$-Calculus for Causal Variational Principles: An Exterior Differential Calculus on Non-Smooth Spaces
abstract: A differential calculus for causal variational principles is developed, which generalizes the exterior calculus of differential forms and some of the associated differential topological structures to non-smooth spaces. Our calculus includes the exterior derivative, de Rham cohomology, glueing constructions (restrictions and extensions of differential forms, Mayer-Vietoris sequence), a Künneth formula and Poincar{é}'s lemma. Moreover, we prove versions of Stokes' theorem and the Gauß divergence theorem. The constructions and results are illustrated by several examples.
summary: 发展了因果变分原理的微分学，它将微分形式的外微积分和一些相关的微分拓扑结构推广到非光滑空间。我们的微积分包括外导数、de Rham 上同调、粘合结构（微分形式的限制和扩展、Mayer-Vietoris 序列）、Künneth 公式和 Poincar{é} 引理。此外，我们还证明了斯托克斯定理和高斯散度定理的版本。通过几个例子说明了结构和结果。

title: Theoretical analysis of the maximum range of a projectile released from a pendulum
abstract: The motion of a projectile released from a simple pendulum is analyzed, with particular emphasis on investigating the optimal release angle that maximizes the horizontal range and the corresponding maximum range. This system serves as a simplified model of the Tarzan jump problem. Using simple analytical methods, the optimal release angle is shown to be characterized by a cubic equation and to increase with the initial velocity. In addition, asymptotic expressions for both the optimal angle and maximum range are derived in the limits of low and high initial velocity.
summary: 分析了从简单摆释放的弹丸的运动，特别强调研究使水平范围最大化的最佳释放角度以及相应的最大射程。该系统作为泰山跳跃问题的简化模型。使用简单的分析方法，最佳释放角度由三次方程表征，并且随着初始速度的增加而增加。此外，在低初速度和高初速度的限制下推导了最佳角度和最大范围的渐近表达式。

title: Eigenvalue asymptotics for the one-particle density matrix and one-particle kinetic energy density operator
abstract: Let $\psi({\mathbf x})$, ${\mathbf x} \in{\mathbb R}^{3N}$, be an eigenfunction of the $N$-particle atomic Schrödinger operator. We consider the one-particle density matrix $\gamma(x, y)$ and one-particle kinetic energy density $\varkappa(x, y)$, $x, y\in {\mathbb R}^3$, associated with the eigenfunction $\psi$. Both functions play a central role in quantum chemistry computations of atomic and molecular bound states: the knowledge of the eigenvalue behaviour of the integral operators ${\sf{\Gamma}}$ and ${\sf{K}}$ with kernels $\gamma(x, y)$ and $\varkappa(x, y)$ serves to estimate the errors due to finite-dimensional approximations. We find the following asymptotic formulas for their eigenvalues $\lambda_k({\sf{\Gamma}})>0$ and $\lambda_k({\sf{K}})>0$: \[ \lim_{k\to \infty} k^{\frac{8}{3}} \,\lambda_k({\sf{\Gamma}}) = A^{\frac{8}{3}},\quad \lim_{k\to \infty} k^2\,\lambda_k({\sf{K}}) = B^2, \] where $A$ and $B$ are non-negative constants given explicitly in terms of the eigenfunction $\psi$. These asymptotics are determined by the singularities of the function $\psi$ at pair coalescence points of the particles. To identify and isolate these singularities we use some recent regularity results for $\psi$. At the last step we apply Birman-Solomyak spectral asymptotics results for pseudodifferential operators with homogeneous symbols. In the special case where the eigenfunction $\psi$ is totally antisymmetric, it exhibits enhanced regularity, which leads to a faster decay of the eigenvalues $\lambda_k(\sf{\Gamma})$ and $\lambda_k(\sf{K})$. The asymptotic formulas take the form \[ \lim_{k\to \infty} k^{\frac{10}{3}} \,\lambda_k({\sf\Gamma}) = \big(A_{asym}\big)^{\frac{10}{3}},\quad \lim_{k\to \infty} k^{\frac{8}{3}} \,\lambda_k({\sf K}) = \big(B_{asym}\big)^{\frac{8}{3}}, \] where $A_{asym}$ and $B_{asym}$ are non-negative constants given explicitly in terms of the gradient of $\psi$.
summary:
令 $\psi({\mathbf x})$, ${\mathbf x} \in{\mathbb R}^{3N}$ 为 $N$ 粒子原子薛定谔算子的本征函数。我们考虑与特征函数 $\psi$ 相关的单粒子密度矩阵 $\gamma(x, y)$ 和单粒子动能密度 $\varkappa(x, y)$、$x, y\in {\mathbb R}^3$。这两个函数在原子和分子束缚态的量子化学计算中发挥着核心作用：了解带有内核 $\gamma(x, y)$ 和 $\varkappa(x, y)$ 的积分算子 ${\sf{\Gamma}}$ 和 ${\sf{K}}$ 的特征值行为可用于估计由于有限维近似而产生的误差。我们找到其特征值 $\lambda_k({\sf{\Gamma}})>0$ 和 $\lambda_k({\sf{K}})>0$ 的渐近公式： \[ \lim_{k\to \infty} k^{\frac{8}{3}} \,\lambda_k({\sf{\Gamma}}) = A^{\frac{8}{3}},\quad \lim_{k\to \infty} k^2\,\lambda_k({\sf{K}}) = B^2, \] 其中 $A$ 和 $B$ 是根据特征函数 $\psi$ 显式给出的非负常数。这些渐近是由粒子成对合并点处的函数 $\psi$ 的奇点决定的。

为了识别和隔离这些奇点，我们使用 $\psi$ 的一些最近的规律性结果。最后一步，我们将 Birman-Solomyak 谱渐近结果应用于具有齐次符号的伪微分算子。在特征函数 $\psi$ 完全反对称的特殊情况下，它表现出增强的规律性，从而导致特征值 $\lambda_k(\sf{\Gamma})$ 和 $\lambda_k(\sf{K})$ 更快地衰减。渐近公式的形式为 \[ \lim_{k\to \infty} k^{\frac{10}{3}} \,\lambda_k({\sf\Gamma}) = \big(A_{asym}\big)^{\frac{10}{3}},\quad \lim_{k\to \infty} k^{\frac{8}{3}} \,\lambda_k({\sf K}) = \big(B_{asym}\big)^{\frac{8}{3}}, \] 其中 $A_{asym}$ 和 $B_{asym}$ 是根据 $\psi$ 梯度明确给出的非负常数。

title: The determinant of the Dirichlet-to-Neumann map for a surface with boundary and periods of holomorphic differentials on its double
abstract: Let $(M,g)$ be a smooth orientable $2d$ Riemannian manifold of genus $\mathfrak{g}$ with Riemannian metric $g$ and connected boundary $\Gamma$. Let $\Lambda$ be the Dirichlet-to-Neumann map on $\Gamma$ and let ${\rm det}_\zeta(\Lambda)$ be its (modified, i. e. with zero mode excluded) $\zeta$-regularized determinant. It is well-known that the quantity ${\rm det}_\zeta(\Lambda)/|\Gamma|$ (where $|\Gamma|$ is the length of $\Gamma$) is a conformal invariant. It was shown by Edward and Wu (\cite{EV}) that this invariant equals one for $\mathfrak{g}=0$; in the case $\mathfrak{g}>0$ Guillarmou and Guillopé \cite{Guillarmou} found two explicit expressions for this invariant through the Rouelle and (respectively) the Selberg zeta-functions of the two surfaces of negative constant curvature from the conformal class of $(M,g)$: one is of infinite volume and complete whereas another has geodesic boundary. We present an elementary counterpart of the formulae of Guillarmou and Guillopé using the periods of holomorphic differentials on the double $2M$ of $M$ only. Our approach is based on the properties of the Hilbert transform of $M$ \cite{B,HilbKor} and the Kontsevich-Vishik-Friedlander-Guillemin regularization of the determinants of pseudodifferenial operators \cite{KV,Ww,F}. In particular, a connection between the length spectra of (uniformized) $M$, $2M$ and the periods of holomorphic differentials on $2M$ is established.
summary:
令 $(M,g)$ 为属 $\mathfrak{g}$ 的光滑可定向 $2d$ 黎曼流形，具有黎曼度量 $g$ 和连接边界 $\Gamma$。令 $\Lambda$ 为 $\Gamma$ 上的狄利克雷到诺依曼映射，并令 ${\rm det}_\zeta(\Lambda)$ 为其（修改后的，即排除零模式）$\zeta$ 正则化行列式。众所周知，数量 ${\rm det}_\zeta(\Lambda)/|\Gamma|$ （其中 $|\Gamma|$ 是 $\Gamma$ 的长度）是一个保角不变量。 Edward 和 Wu (\cite{EV}) 证明，当 $\mathfrak{g}=0$ 时，这个不变量等于 1；在 $\mathfrak{g}>0$ 的情况下，Guillarmou 和 Guillopé \cite{Guillarmou} 通过 Rouelle 和（分别）来自 $(M,g)$ 共形类的两个负常曲率表面的 Selberg zeta 函数找到了该不变量的两个显式表达式：一个具有无限体积且完整，而另一个具有测地线边界。我们仅使用 $M$ 的双 $2M$ 上的全纯微分周期，提出 Guillarmou 和 Guillopé 公式的基本对应项。

我们的方法基于 $M$ \cite{B,HilbKor} 的希尔伯特变换的性质和伪微分算子行列式的 Kontsevich-Vishik-Friedlander-Guillemin 正则化 \cite{KV,Ww,F}。特别是，建立了（均匀）$M$、$2M$ 的长度谱与 $2M$ 上的全纯微分周期之间的联系。

title: Emergent Problem-Graph Alignment in RL-Discovered Entanglement Topologies for QAOA
abstract: In the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA), the entanglement topology, where qubit pairs are connected by two-qubit gates, is conventionally set equal to the edge set of the problem graph. This coupling ties circuit design to explicit problem knowledge and may not yield the most trainable circuit under limited optimization budgets. We investigate whether a reinforcement learning (RL) agent can discover more effective entanglement topologies for QAOA-based MaxCut optimization without direct access to the problem graph. A Masked Proximal Policy Optimization agent sequentially places IsingZZ gates to construct a circuit topology, while a variational inner loop optimizes the resulting QAOA parameters and returns the approximation ratio as a sparse terminal reward. The agent's observation contains only the edges placed so far and the current approximation ratio; graph structure can only be inferred indirectly through the optimization reward. On Erdős--Rényi instances with up to $10$~qubits, the agent consistently converges to topologies that are strict subsets of the problem graph, achieving overlap ratios approaching $1.0$, despite receiving no explicit information about the graph structure in its observations. These sparse, problem-aligned topologies outperform the full graph topology and several structural baselines when the optimization budget is limited ($50$~gradient steps), but are overtaken by denser topologies given sufficient optimization budget. Our results reveal a trainability--expressibility trade-off governed by topology density and suggest that the variational optimization landscape implicitly encodes structural information about the problem Hamiltonian.
summary:
在量子近似优化算法（QAOA）中，纠缠拓扑（其中量子位对通过两个量子位门连接）通常设置为等于问题图的边集。这种耦合将电路设计与明确的问题知识联系在一起，并且在有限的优化预算下可能无法产生最可训练的电路。我们研究强化学习（RL）代理是否可以在不直接访问问题图的情况下为基于 QAOA 的 MaxCut 优化发现更有效的纠缠拓扑。掩码近端策略优化代理按顺序放置 IsingZZ 门来构建电路拓扑，而变分内循环则优化生成的 QAOA 参数并返回近似率作为稀疏终端奖励。代理的观察仅包含到目前为止放置的边缘和当前的近似比率；图结构只能通过优化奖励间接推断。

在具有高达 $10$~量子位的 Erdős-Rényi 实例上，代理始终收敛到作为问题图的严格子集的拓扑，实现接近 $1.0$ 的重叠率，尽管在其观察中没有收到有关图结构的明确信息。当优化预算有限（50 美元〜梯度步骤）时，这些稀疏的、与问题对齐的拓扑优于全图拓扑和多个结构基线，但在给定足够的优化预算的情况下，会被更密集的拓扑所超越。我们的结果揭示了由拓扑密度控制的可训练性-可表达性权衡，并表明变分优化景观隐式编码有关问题哈密顿量的结构信息。

title: Preparing approximate $N$-fold cat states with the phase space instruction set
abstract: The phase space instruction set is a continuous-variable universal gate set involving single-qubit rotations and qubit-dependent displacements on a single boson. Using these gates, we prove that a circuit depth $\mathrm{\Omega}(\varphi(N))$ is necessary to approximately prepare a large $N$-fold rotationally invariant Schrödinger cat state; here $\varphi(N) \gtrsim N/\log\log N$ is the Euler totient function. A protocol saturating this asymptotic bound on circuit depth is obtained for every prime number $N$. This protocol has an asymptotically optimal runtime, when the gates are generated by Hamiltonian evolution. Our results provide a sharp example where a universal gate set is surprisingly inefficient at preparing a simple family of states, and further imply that converting bosonic circuits between different universal gate sets can be extremely inefficient.
summary: 相空间指令集是连续变量通用门集，涉及单个玻色子上的单量子位旋转和依赖于量子位的位移。使用这些门，我们证明电路深度 $\mathrm{\Omega}(\varphi(N))$ 对于近似准备一个大的 $​​N$ 倍旋转不变薛定谔猫状态是必要的；这里 $\varphi(N) \gtrsim N/\log\log N$ 是欧拉 totient 函数。对于每个质数$N$，获得了使电路深度的渐近界限饱和的协议。当门由哈密顿演化生成时，该协议具有渐近最优运行时间。我们的结果提供了一个尖锐的例子，其中通用门组在准备简单的状态族时出奇地低效，并进一步暗示在不同通用门组之间转换玻色子电路可能极其低效。

title: The Case for the Everett Multiverse
abstract: I give a non-technical presentation of the argument that quantum mechanics, in the form in which it is currently used, needs to be understood in many-worlds (Everettian) terms; the alternatives that have been discussed are at present not able to reproduce the full empirical content of the theory. This is a draft of a chapter for the forthcoming \emph{Blackwell Companion to Philosophy and the Multiverse (Klaas Kraay and Daniel Rubio, eds.) }
summary: 我以非技术性的方式阐述了这样的论点：量子力学，就目前使用的形式而言，需要用多世界（埃弗里特）术语来理解；目前已经讨论的替代方案无法重现该理论的全部经验内容。这是即将出版的 \emph{Blackwell Companion to Philosophy and the Multiverse（Klaas Kraay 和 Daniel Rubio，eds.））的一章草稿。

title: Randomized product formulas beyond optimal deterministic scaling
abstract: Product formulas, also known as Trotter formulas, are among the most widely used and practical methods for simulating quantum systems on quantum computers. Here we introduce two new classes of randomized product formulas for simulating Hamiltonians with separated energy scales, $H=A+\alpha B$, where $\alpha$ is small. In the standard access model, where one can implement exponentials of $A$ and $B$ separately, our randomized formulas achieve $\mathcal O(\alpha^2)$ error scaling at the cost of only doubling the gate depth of the corresponding deterministic formula. We further prove an $\Omega(\alpha)$ lower bound for deterministic product formulas. In a stronger access model, allowing exponentials of $A+\alpha B_\ell$ for $B = \sum_{\ell}B_\ell$, our randomized formula, based on Trotter Heuristic Resource Improved Formulas for Time-dynamics (THRIFT)~[J. L. Bosse et al., Nat. Commun. 16, 2673 (2025)], achieves $\mathcal O(\alpha^3)$ error scaling with only constant-factor expected gate overhead. We also establish an $\Omega(\alpha^2)$ lower bound for deterministic product formulas in this access model. Numerical simulations confirm gate-count reductions for simulating physically motivated systems.
summary:
乘积公式，也称为 Trotter 公式，是在量子计算机上模拟量子系统的最广泛使用和实用的方法之一。在这里，我们引入两类新的随机乘积公式，用于模拟具有分离能量尺度的哈密顿量，$H=A+\alpha B$，其中 $\alpha$ 很小。在标准访问模型中，可以分别实现 $A$ 和 $B$ 的指数，我们的随机公式可以实现 $\mathcal O(\alpha^2)$ 误差缩放，而代价只是将相应确定性公式的门深度加倍。我们进一步证明了确定性乘积公式的 $\Omega(\alpha)$ 下界。在更强的访问模型中，允许 $A+\alpha B_\ell$ 为 $B = \sum_{\ell}B_\ell$ 的指数，我们的随机公式基于 Trotter Heuristic Resource Improves Formulas for Time-dynamics (THRIFT)~[J. L. Bosse 等人，Nat。交流。 16, 2673 (2025)]，仅用常数因子预期门开销即可实现 $\mathcal O(\alpha^3)$ 误差缩放。我们还为该访问模型中的确定性乘积公式建立了 $\Omega(\alpha^2)$ 下界。

数值模拟证实了模拟物理驱动系统的门数减少。

title: Emergent Non-Markovian Nonlinear Qubit From Collective Spin Interactions
