abstract: Open-system descriptions are typically introduced by coupling a quantum system to an external environment. Here we show that a closed interacting many-body system can itself generate a controlled non-Markovian quantum channel acting on a reduced nonlinear qubit through finite-size corrections to a nonlinear mean-field limit. We demonstrate this using the Kitagawa-Ueda one-axis twisting model, $H=\chi J_z^2$, a paradigmatic model of collective spin dynamics, spin squeezing, and two-component Bose-Einstein condensates. Although the large-$N$ regime of this model has been extensively studied, the conventional fixed-$\chi$ scaling does not yield a nontrivial dynamical large-$N$ limit. In this paper, we investigate a complementary large-$N$ formulation obtained from the double limit $N\rightarrow\infty$ and $\chi\rightarrow O(g/N)$, where $g$ is a coupling constant. We derive the leading finite-$N$ corrections to this limit and show that they correspond to an emergent non-Markovian dephasing process, producing a Gaussian decay of the Bloch-vector coherence with characteristic timescale $t_\varphi\geq\sqrt{N}/(2g)$. Exact finite-$N$ calculations demonstrate that this effective open-system description becomes quantitatively accurate for systems containing on the order of one hundred qubits. The resulting framework provides a microscopic realization of non-Markovian dephasing generated intrinsically by a closed many-body system and enables efficient simulation of collective quantum dynamics beyond unitary mean-field theory. These results link the long-studied phenomenon of phase diffusion in atomic ensembles and Bose-Einstein condensates to the growing effort to characterize non-Markovian, beyond-Lindblad noise in quantum computing hardware, providing a rare case in which such a noise channel is derived from microscopic dynamics rather than fit phenomenologically.
summary:
开放系统描述通常是通过将量子系统耦合到外部环境来引入的。在这里，我们表明，一个封闭的相互作用的多体系统本身可以生成一个受控的非马尔可夫量子通道，通过对非线性平均场极限的有限尺寸校正，作用于简化的非线性量子位。我们使用 Kitakawa-Ueda 单轴扭曲模型 $H=\chi J_z^2$ 来证明这一点，它是集体自旋动力学、自旋挤压和二元玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的范例模型。尽管该模型的大$N$机制已被广泛研究，但传统的固定$\chi$缩放不会产生非平凡的动态大$N$限制。在本文中，我们研究了从双重极限 $N\rightarrow\infty$ 和 $\chi\rightarrow O(g/N)$ 获得的互补大 $N$ 公式，其中 $g$ 是耦合常数。我们推导了对此极限的主要有限 $N$ 校正，并表明它们对应于新兴的非马尔可夫相移过程，产生具有特征时间尺度 $t_\varphi\geq\sqrt{N}/(2g)$ 的布洛赫矢量相干性的高斯衰减。

精确的有限 $N$ 计算表明，对于包含一百个量子位的系统，这种有效的开放系统描述在数量上变得准确。由此产生的框架提供了封闭多体系统本质上产生的非马尔可夫相移的微观实现，并且能够有效模拟超越酉平均场理论的集体量子动力学。这些结果将长期研究的原子系综和玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚中的相扩散现象与在量子计算硬件中表征非马尔可夫、超林布拉德噪声的不断努力联系起来，提供了一种罕见的情况，其中这种噪声通道源自微观动力学而不是现象学上的拟合。

title: Multistage Rewinding Decoder for QLDPC Codes
abstract: In this paper, we propose a multistage decoding framework that leverages internal information produced by an underlying message-passing decoder. The proposed method targets the failure dynamics caused by both classical trapping sets and degenerate errors supported on symmetric stabilizers, which are among the primary limitations of iterative decoding for QLDPC codes. To identify unreliable variable nodes, we introduce a heuristic metric that combines several dynamical features of the decoder, including variable-node log likelihood reliabilities, hard-decision oscillations, the number of adjacent unsatisfied checks, and the soft information contributed by unsatisfied checks. Based on this ranking metric, the decoder performs guided rewinds by selectively forcing the initial log likelihood ratio values of the most suspicious variable nodes and restarting the message-passing decoder under the corresponding forced configuration. To manage the combinatorial growth of candidate configurations, the search is formulated within a beam- search framework with controlled beam width. In addition, we introduce a pruning metric based on the combination of the residual syndrome weight and a posteriori reliability of the decoder output, thereby retaining only the most promising search paths. Logical error rate results demonstrate that the proposed decoder significantly outperforms the normalized min- sum decoder and achieves competitive performance with belief propagation enhanced by order-10 ordered statistics decoding.
summary:
在本文中，我们提出了一种多级解码框架，该框架利用底层消息传递解码器产生的内部信息。所提出的方法针对由经典捕获集和对称稳定器支持的简并误差引起的失效动态，这是 QLDPC 码迭代解码的主要限制之一。为了识别不可靠的变量节点，我们引入了一种启发式度量，它结合了解码器的几个动态特征，包括变量节点对数似然可靠性、硬决策振荡、相邻不满足检查的数量以及不满足检查贡献的软信息。基于此排序度量，解码器通过选择性地强制最可疑变量节点的初始对数似然比值并在相应的强制配置下重新启动消息传递解码器来执行引导倒带。为了管理候选配置的组合增长，在具有受控波束宽度的波束搜索框架内制定搜索。

此外，我们引入了基于残余校正子权重和解码器输出的后验可靠性相结合的修剪度量，从而仅保留最有希望的搜索路径。逻辑错误率结果表明，所提出的解码器显着优于归一化最小和解码器，并且通过 10 阶有序统计解码增强的置信传播实现了有竞争力的性能。

title: Playing Nonlocal Games with Little to No Shared Randomness
abstract: Bell nonlocality reveals correlations that cannot be explained by classical models and plays a central role in quantum information theory. In this work, we investigate classical models of Bell nonlocality under restrictions on shared randomness. For bipartite scenarios with bounded shared randomness, the set of classical correlations becomes nonconvex. We characterize the correlations achievable without shared randomness through the simultaneous evaluation of multiple linear Bell functionals. We then extend our analysis to quantum networks by relaxing the standard assumption of source independence. In this setting, the feasibility constraints derived for the bipartite case can be used to certify source dependence, and we further construct nonlinear inequalities that distinguish classical models with correlated sources from correlations achievable in standard quantum networks. As an application, we show that these nonlinear network inequalities give rise to an entropic Bell inequality for bipartite scenarios with limited shared randomness.
summary: 贝尔非定域性揭示了经典模型无法解释的相关性，并在量子信息论中发挥着核心作用。在这项工作中，我们研究了共享随机性限制下贝尔非定域性的经典模型。对于具有有限共享随机性的二分场景，经典相关性集变得非凸。我们通过同时评估多个线性贝尔泛函来描述在没有共享随机性的情况下可实现的相关性。然后，我们通过放宽源独立性的标准假设将我们的分析扩展到量子网络。在这种情况下，针对二分情况导出的可行性约束可用于证明源依赖性，并且我们进一步构造非线性不等式，将具有相关源的经典模型与标准量子网络中可实现的相关性区分开来。作为一个应用，我们证明这些非线性网络不等式会导致共享随机性有限的二分场景的熵贝尔不等式。

title: Biorthogonal-only Floquet Dynamical Quantum Phase Transitions
abstract: Non-Hermitian dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPTs) are intrinsically sensitive to the choice of inner product under nonunitary time evolution. Although the biorthogonal formulation based on associated states provides a normalized Loschmidt echo with a probabilistic interpretation, previous studies have found biorthogonal and self-normal DQPTs to occur in the same parameter regimes, suggesting that the two forms of dynamical criticality are concomitant. Here we demonstrate that this is not the case. In an exactly solvable periodically driven non-Hermitian Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chain, we uncover a finite biorthogonal-only Floquet DQPT regime, where the biorthogonal Loschmidt rate becomes nonanalytic while the self-normal Loschmidt rate remains smooth. The critical conditions are obtained analytically, showing that the onset of biorthogonal Floquet DQPTs is locked to the exceptional lines of the effective Floquet Hamiltonian, whereas self-normal criticality has no corresponding spectral boundary. Moreover, for each critical momentum, the biorthogonal DQPT exhibits a pair of critical times within every driving period, whereas the self-normal DQPT exhibits only one. Our results establish a fundamental distinction between biorthogonal and self-normal DQPTs, thereby opening a route toward new nonequilibrium quantum phenomena in non-Hermitian systems.
summary:
非厄米动态量子相变（DQPT）本质上对非酉时间演化下内积的选择敏感。虽然基于相关状态的双正交公式提供了具有概率解释的归一化洛施密特回波，但先前的研究发现双正交和自正态 DQPT 发生在相同的参数范围内，这表明两种形式的动力学临界性是同时存在的。在这里我们证明事实并非如此。在完全可解的周期性驱动的非埃尔米特 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 链中，我们发现了一个有限双正交 Floquet DQPT 体系，其中双正交洛施密特速率变得非解析，而自正常洛施密特速率保持平滑。通过分析获得了临界条件，表明双正交 Floquet DQPT 的起始点被锁定到有效 Floquet 哈密顿量的异常线，而自法线临界性没有相应的谱边界。此外，对于每个临界动量，双正交 DQPT 在每个驾驶周期内都表现出一对临界时间，而自归一化 DQPT 仅表现出一个。

我们的结果建立了双正交 DQPT 和自正规 DQPT 之间的根本区别，从而为非厄米系统中新的非平衡量子现象开辟了道路。

title: Breaking the Curse of Dimensionality in Quantum PDE Solvers via Gevrey Regularity
abstract: We connect different degrees of smoothness of real-valued periodic functions to the cost of preparing their high-precision Fourier-basis amplitude encodings as quantum states. Our central observation is that the Gevrey hierarchy, which stratifies the space between smooth and analytic functions, provides a natural class for high-precision quantum algorithms. We then specialize to solving general linear partial differential equations (PDEs), showing how our Fourier methods do so efficiently at varying target precisions on a quantum computer. This also demonstrates how our framework enables passage from query-complexity results to explicit elementary gate counts. As an application, we introduce a hierarchy of many-body quantum simulation pipelines that harness these high-precision algorithms to probe the linear response of atomistic systems in first quantization. Each level of the hierarchy unlocks a further polynomial-degree quantum speedup, yielding a gradual improvement in simulation efficiency as quantum computers scale.
summary: 我们将实值周期函数的不同平滑度与将其高精度傅里叶基幅度编码准备为量子态的成本联系起来。我们的中心观察是，Gevrey 层次结构对平滑函数和解析函数之间的空间进行了分层，为高精度量子算法提供了一个自然的类。然后，我们专门求解一般线性偏微分方程 (PDE)，展示我们的傅里叶方法如何在量子计算机上以不同的目标精度高效地求解。这也演示了我们的框架如何实现从查询复杂性结果到显式基本门计数的传递。作为一个应用程序，我们引入了多体量子模拟管道的层次结构，利用这些高精度算法来探测原子系统在首次量化中的线性响应。该层次结构的每个级别都解锁了进一步的多项式量子加速，随着量子计算机的扩展，模拟效率逐渐提高。

title: Stable three-dimensional solitons in spin-orbit-coupled atomic-molecular condensates
abstract: We elaborate a mechanism for the creation of stable three-dimensional (3D) solitons in spin-orbit-coupled (SOC) atomic-molecular Bose-Einstein condensate, modeled by the mean-field equations with the quadratic three-wave interaction, characterized by mismatch $\alpha $. The planar (effectively two-dimensional) SOC is applied to the soliton's atomic component, structuring it as a mixed mode (MM) or semi-vortex (SV). The molecular component of the SV soliton is shaped as a 3D vortex, while the molecular component in the MM soliton is an MM too. The solitons exist up to a critical value of $\alpha $. The system demonstrates a relatively large norm share of the vortex components, exceeding $50\%$ of the total norm, which is an essential feature of SOC-supported solitons. This is scheme for realizing stable vortex solitons in free space with the quadratic nonlinearity.
summary: 我们阐述了一种在自旋轨道耦合（SOC）原子分子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中产生稳定三维（3D）孤子的机制，该机制通过具有二次三波相互作用的平均场方程进行建模，其特征是失配$\alpha$。平面（实际上是二维）SOC 应用于孤子的原子组件，将其构造为混合模式 (MM) 或半涡旋 (SV)。 SV孤子的分子成分形状为3D涡旋，而MM孤子的分子成分也是MM。孤子的存在达到临界值 $\alpha $。该系统展示了涡旋分量相对较大的范数份额，超过总范数的 50\%$，这是 SOC 支持的孤子的基本特征。这是在自由空间中实现具有二次非线性的稳定涡旋孤子的方案。

title: Near-Optimal Gap Amplification for Nonnegative Unentangled Quantum Proofs
abstract: We study gap amplification of the class $\mathsf{QMA}^{+}(2)$ characterized by unentangled quantum proofs whose amplitudes are nonnegative in the computational basis. This class was recently introduced by Jeronimo and Wu (STOC 2023), and its behavior depends sharply on the completeness-soundness gap: although it captures the power of $\mathsf{NEXP}$ for some small constant gap, it is equal to $\mathsf{QMA}(2)$ for larger constant gap. This is in stark contrast to $\mathsf{QMA}(2)$ where strong gap amplification is known due to the product test by Harrow and Montanaro (FOCS 2010, JACM 2013). In this paper, we prove for every completeness $c$ and soundness $s$ with $c-s=1/\mathrm{poly}(n)$, \[ \mathsf{NEXP} = \mathsf{QMA}^{+}(2,c,s) = \mathsf{QMA}^{+}\left(2,1-\frac1{\mathrm{poly}(n)},\frac14+\frac1{\mathrm{poly}(n)}\right). \] Our result gives a clean complexity phase transition for $\mathsf{QMA}^{+}(2)$ since we have \[ \mathsf{QMA}^{\mathbb R}(2) = \mathsf{QMA}^{+}\left(2,1-\frac1{\mathrm{poly}(n)},\frac14-\frac1{\mathrm{poly}(n)}\right), \] where $\mathsf{QMA}^{\mathbb R}(2)$ denotes $\mathsf{QMA}(2)$ with witnesses restricted to real amplitudes. Our amplification is thus optimal in the sense that a slight improvement of our soundness would have the collapse \[ \mathsf{QMA}^{\mathbb R}(2)=\mathsf{NEXP}. \] Our proof combines symmetric-subspace projections with the relation $\mathsf{QMA}^{+}(1)=\mathsf{NEXP}$ of Bassirian, Fefferman, and Marwaha (ITCS 2024). The main technical ingredient is a dimension-independent de Finetti theorem in Hilbert-Schmidt norm that applies when the number of registers under consideration grows logarithmically.
summary:
我们研究 $\mathsf{QMA}^{+}(2)$ 类的间隙放大，其特征是非纠缠量子证明，其幅度在计算基础上为非负。这个类最近由 Jeronimo 和 Wu (STOC 2023) 引入，它的行为很大程度上取决于完整性和健全性差距：虽然它在一些小的常数差距上捕获了 $\mathsf{NEXP}$ 的力量，但对于较大的常数差距，它等于 $\mathsf{QMA}(2)$ 。这与 $\mathsf{QMA}(2)$ 形成鲜明对比，其中由于 Harrow 和 Montanaro 的产品测试（FOCS 2010，JACM 2013），已知强间隙放大。在本文中，我们用 $c-s=1/\mathrm{poly}(n)$, \[ \mathsf{NEXP} = \mathsf{QMA}^{+}(2,c,s) = 证明每个完整性 $c$ 和健全性 $s$ \mathsf{QMA}^{+}\left(2,1-\frac1{\mathrm{poly}(n)},\frac14+\frac1{\mathrm{poly}(n)}\right)。 \] 我们的结果给出了 $\mathsf{QMA}^{+}(2)$ 的清晰复杂性相变，因为我们有 \[ \mathsf{QMA}^{\mathbb R}(2) = \mathsf{QMA}^{+}\left(2,1-\frac1{\mathrm{poly}(n)},\frac14-\frac1{\mathrm{poly}(n)}\right), \]其中$\mathsf{QMA}^{\mathbb R}(2)$表示$\mathsf{QMA}(2)$，见证人仅限于真实振幅。

因此，我们的放大是最佳的，因为我们的稳健性的轻微改善就会导致崩溃 \[ \mathsf{QMA}^{\mathbb R}(2)=\mathsf{NEXP}。 \] 我们的证明将对称子空间投影与 Bassirian、Fefferman 和 Marwaha 的关系 $\mathsf{QMA}^{+}(1)=\mathsf{NEXP}$ 结合起来 (ITCS 2024)。主要技术成分是 Hilbert-Schmidt 范数中与维度无关的 de Finetti 定理，该定理适用于所考虑的寄存器数量呈对数增长时。

title: Quantum Decision Theory for Displacement Detection with Finite-Energy GKP States
abstract: We develop a quantum-decision-theoretic framework for detecting phase-space displacements with finite-energy, $d$-level Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) probes. For single-mode and entanglement-assisted architectures, we derive the Bayesian minimum-error probability, the optimal Neyman-Pearson receiver-operating characteristic, and the corresponding minimum detectable displacement. Finite-energy effects are treated through exact theta-series displacement kernels, while pure loss followed by quantum-limited amplification is mapped to an effective Gaussian random-displacement channel. Entanglement removes preparation-dependent blind directions and preserves both logical displacement labels, although it does not surpass the pointwise optimized single-mode strategy in the noiseless pure-state setting. We benchmark the resulting protocols against coherent-state, direction-matched squeezed-vacuum, and twin-beam schemes at equal nominal squeezing. Numerical results identify finite-squeezing and lossy regimes in which GKP probes achieve both a lower Bayesian error and a smaller minimum detectable perturbation than the selected Gaussian receivers.
summary: 我们开发了一个量子决策理论框架，用于使用有限能量、$d$ 级 Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) 探针检测相空间位移。对于单模和纠缠辅助架构，我们推导了贝叶斯最小误差概率、最佳内曼-皮尔逊接收器操作特性以及相应的最小可检测位移。有限能量效应通过精确的 theta 级数位移核来处理，而纯损耗和量子有限放大则被映射到有效的高斯随机位移通道。纠缠消除了与准备相关的盲方向并保留了两个逻辑位移标签，尽管它没有超越无噪声纯状态设置中的逐点优化单模策略。我们将所得协议与相干态、方向匹配压缩真空和相同名义压缩下的双光束方案进行基准测试。数值结果确定了有限压缩和有损状态，其中 GKP 探测器比所选高斯接收器实现了更低的贝叶斯误差和更小的最小可检测扰动。

title: Time-reparameterisation invariant quantum evolution law: the lack of absolute time does not imply a stationary global state
abstract: We challenge the common belief that if there is no absolute time parameter in physics, a quantum system described without reference to an external clock can be assumed to be in a stationary state of its Hamiltonian. We present a time-reparameterisation invariant quantum evolution law, which for a given initial condition predicts the same trajectory in state space as the Schrödinger equation, except that for nontrivial trajectories it does not predict the speed at which the trajectory is traversed. The solutions of this evolution law are all time-reparameterised solutions of the Schrödinger equation. We show how the predictions of the Schrödinger equation are recovered relative to an internal clock in this framework. In contrast to the Page-Wootters formalism or Dirac's quantisation of the Hamiltonian constraint, here the global sate is not stationary. We discuss the assumptions leading to the common conclusion that the state can be taken stationary and suggest that they need to be revisited.
summary: 我们挑战这样一种普遍观点：如果物理学中不存在绝对时间参数，则可以假定在不参考外部时钟的情况下描述的量子系统处于其哈密顿量的稳态。我们提出了一种时间重参数化不变的量子演化定律，对于给定的初始条件，该定律预测状态空间中与薛定谔方程相同的轨迹，但对于非平凡轨迹，它不预测轨迹穿过的速度。该演化定律的解都是薛定谔方程的时间重参数化解。我们展示了如何相对于该框架中的内部时钟恢复薛定谔方程的预测。与佩奇-伍特斯形式主义或狄拉克的哈密顿量约束的量化相反，这里的全局状态不是静止的。我们讨论了得出共同结论的假设，即状态可以被视为静止，并建议需要重新审视它们。

title: Gravitational Casimir-Polder interaction in a thermal bath
abstract: We have investigated, by separating the contributions from thermal fluctuations (tf) and the radiation reaction (rr), the gravitational Casimir-Polder interaction between a gravitationally polarizable two-level object and an infinite gravitational Dirichlet boundary in a thermal bath at a temperature $T$. The results indicate that the rr-contribution to the interaction potential is independent of the temperature, whereas the tf-contribution is generally governed by a nontrivial interplay between the thermal corrections and the polarization effect. Here, the object-to-boundary distance, the characteristic transition wavelength of the object and the thermal wavelength of gravitons are denoted by $L$, $\lambda$ and $\beta$, respectively. In contrast to the vacuum case, where the interaction potential scales as $L^{-5}$ for $L\ll\lambda$ and $L^{-6}$ for $L\gg\lambda$, corresponding to an always repulsive force, qualitatively new behaviors emerge at high temperatures. Particularly, when $\sqrt[4]{\beta\lambda^3}\ll L\ll\lambda$ and the object is polarizable within the plane perpendicular to the boundary, a novel scaling of $TL^{-1}$ arises; when $\sqrt{\beta\lambda}\ll L\ll\lambda$ and the object is polarizable along the vertical-to-boundary axis, the interaction force becomes surprisingly attractive. At extremely high temperatures and large distances, i.e. when $\beta\ll \lambda\ll L$, the potential oscillates with the distance $L$ and thus an attractive or repulsive and even vanishing force can be resulted, depending on the exact values of $L$. Our work demonstrates that thermal gravitons can act as an active control mechanism for quantum gravitational interactions, and temperature, polarization configuration, and object-to-boundary distance jointly determine the magnitude, scaling law, and even the attractive or repulsive nature of the interaction force.
summary:
我们通过分离热涨落 (tf) 和辐射反应 (rr) 的贡献，研究了温度 $T$ 的热浴中引力极化两能级物体与无限引力狄利克雷边界之间的引力卡西米尔-波尔德相互作用。结果表明，rr 对相互作用势的贡献与温度无关，而 tf 贡献通常受热校正和极化效应之间的重要相互作用控制。这里，物体到边界的距离、物体的特征跃迁波长和引力子的热波长分别用$L$、$\lambda$和$\beta$表示。与真空情况相反，其中 $L\ll\lambda$ 的相互作用势为 $L^{-5}$，$L\gg\lambda$ 的相互作用势为 $L^{-6}$，对应于始终存在的排斥力，在高温下会出现定性的新行为。

特别是，当 $\sqrt[4]{\beta\lambda^3}\ll L\ll\lambda$ 且物体在垂直于边界的平面内可极化时，会出现 $TL^{-1}$ 的新颖缩放；当 $\sqrt{\beta\lambda}\ll L\ll\lambda$ 并且物体沿垂直于边界轴可极化时，相互作用力变得令人惊讶地有吸引力。在极高的温度和很远的距离下，即当 $\beta\ll \lambda\ll L$ 时，电势随着距离 $L$ 振荡，因此可能会产生吸引力或排斥力，甚至消失的力，具体取决于 $L$ 的确切值。我们的工作表明，热引力子可以作为量子引力相互作用的主动控制机制，温度、偏振构型和物体到边界的距离共同决定相互作用力的大小、尺度定律，甚至吸引力或排斥力的性质。

title: Preserving Heisenberg-Limited Metrological Information during Storage via Correlated-Noise Correction
abstract: Quantum error correction has become an indispensable tool for restoring Heisenberg-limited precision in noisy quantum metrology. Existing protocols, however, almost exclusively focus on correcting noise during the signal-encoding stage and implicitly assume that the probe is measured immediately after sensing. In many quantum information processing tasks, the encoded probe must instead be stored before subsequent quantum operations, during which environmental noise can significantly degrade the accumulated metrological information. Here, we propose a correlated-noise correction (CNC) protocol for protecting quantum probes during the storage stage. By correlating probe errors with auxiliary qubits through fixed two-body entangling gates, memory errors are converted into measurable syndromes that are extracted only once after storage. We show that the protocol naturally extends from single-qubit to multi-qubit probes and protects the stored quantum Fisher information against dephasing, bit-flip, and amplitude-damping noise. Furthermore, we demonstrate that preserving the quantum Fisher information does not necessarily require restoring the entire quantum state when the probe is measured immediately after storage, whereas full state recovery becomes essential for subsequent rounds of quantum signal processing. Our results establish correlated-noise correction as a practical framework for protecting metrological information during quantum memory and provide a useful building block for sensing-enabled quantum information processing.
summary:
量子误差校正已成为在噪声量子计量中恢复海森堡极限精度不可或缺的工具。然而，现有协议几乎完全专注于在信号编码阶段校正噪声，并隐含地假设探头在感测后立即进行测量。在许多量子信息处理任务中，必须在后续量子操作之前存储编码探针，在此期间环境噪声会显着降低累积的计量信息。在这里，我们提出了一种相关噪声校正（CNC）协议，用于在存储阶段保护量子探针。通过固定的二体纠缠门将探针错误与辅助量子位相关联，内存错误被转换为可测量的综合症，在存储后仅提取一次。我们表明，该协议自然地从单量子位探针扩展到多量子位探针，并保护存储的量子费希尔信息免受相移、位翻转和振幅阻尼噪声的影响。

此外，我们证明，保存量子费希尔信息并不一定需要在存储后立即测量探针时恢复整个量子态，而完整的状态恢复对于后续几轮量子信号处理至关重要。我们的研究结果将相关噪声校正建立为在量子存储期间保护计量信息的实用框架，并为传感启用的量子信息处理提供了有用的构建块。

title: Hamiltonian spectra in quantum computers through the generalized eigenvalue method
abstract: Quantum computers can generate real-time correlators of field theories. By adapting the generalized eigenvalue problem to these correlators, energy eigenvalues can be extracted directly. The method is tested using both classical simulations and quantum hardware, successfully resolving several low-lying energy levels in agreement with exact diagonalization. Comparison with an alternative spectrum determination based on the Fourier transform of correlators shows that the proposed approach is substantially more efficient.
summary: 量子计算机可以生成场论的实时相关器。通过将广义特征值问题应用于这些相关器，可以直接提取能量特征值。该方法使用经典模拟和量子硬件进行了测试，成功解决了与精确对角化一致的几个低能级。与基于相关器傅里叶变换的替代频谱确定的比较表明，所提出的方法明显更有效。

title: Opposite post-processing orders of fermionic horizon channels and their quantum-resource monotonicity
abstract: Relativistic quantum-information studies in noninertial and black-hole settings often determine resource behavior through explicit calculations for particular input states and state functionals, leaving unclear whether the recurring monotonic trends originate from those choices or from a common underlying structure. In this work, we formulate the effective single-mode fermionic horizon transformation as a pair of complementary exterior and interior quantum channels, corresponding respectively to the physically accessible and inaccessible sectors, and establish exact post-processing orders in opposite directions. As the relativistic channel parameter $q$ increases, the exterior channel becomes progressively degraded, whereas the interior channel is ordered in the reverse direction. These relations extend to arbitrary multipartite settings. Consequently, every state functional that is non-increasing under the corresponding intermediate maps is non-increasing in homogeneous exterior sectors and non-decreasing in homogeneous interior sectors. The framework therefore applies to broad classes of quantum resources and correlations, including entanglement and occupation-basis coherence monotones, optimized Bell-functional quantities, and contractive-divergence correlation measures. We further numerically evaluate collective coherence based on the quantum Jensen-Shannon divergence (QJSD) in the Garfinkle-Horowitz-Strominger (GHS) dilaton-black-hole spacetime, illustrating the predicted homogeneous monotonicity. The recurring trends are therefore traced to a common channel-ordering structure, while the physical setting determines the parameterization of $q$ and the resource-theoretic monotonicity determines which output-state quantities inherit the order.
summary:
非惯性和黑洞环境中的相对论量子信息研究通常通过对特定输入状态和状态泛函的显式计算来确定资源行为，从而不清楚反复出现的单调趋势是源于这些选择还是源于共同的基础结构。在这项工作中，我们将有效的单模费米子视界变换表述为一对互补的外部和内部量子通道，分别对应于物理上可访问和不可访问的部分，并在相反的方向上建立精确的后处理顺序。随着相对论通道参数 $q$ 的增加，外部通道逐渐退化，而内部通道则相反。这些关系扩展到任意多方设置。因此，在相应的中间映射下，每一个非递增的国家函数在同质外部部门中都是非递增的，并且在同质内部部门中也是非递减的。

因此，该框架适用于广泛的量子资源和相关性，包括纠缠和占用基相干单调、优化的贝尔泛函量以及收缩散度相关性度量。我们进一步基于加芬克尔-霍洛维茨-斯特罗明格 (GHS) 膨胀子黑洞时空中的量子詹森-香农散度 (QJSD) 来数​​值评估集体相干性，说明了预测的同质单调性。因此，反复出现的趋势可以追溯到共同的通道排序结构，而物理设置确定 $q$ 的参数化，而资源理论的单调性则确定哪些输出状态量继承该顺序。

title: Catching Transpilation Drift with a CI/CD Workflow in Quantum Software Development
abstract: Quantum software workflows rely on compiler and provider toolchains that evolve independently of application source code. Consequently, an unchanged quantum circuit may transpile into a different target-specific realization after changes in SDK versions, optimization settings, basis gates, coupling maps, or backend descriptions. Such transpilation drift can affect circuit depth, gate composition, qubit mapping, and execution behavior, yet it is rarely monitored in CI/CD pipelines. This paper proposes a Quantum DevOps workflow for detecting transpilation drift before execution. The workflow transpiles source circuits against configured target profiles, computes structural drift metrics, records provenance and artifacts in MLflow, and raises configurable warnings or failures in GitHub Actions. Using representative circuits and target profiles, we show how drift checks can expose toolchain-induced changes and support reproducibility audits. The contribution is a practical CI/CD guardrail for making quantum compilation behavior observable, testable, and auditable.
summary: 量子软件工作流程依赖于独立于应用程序源代码而发展的编译器和提供商工具链。因此，在 SDK 版本、优化设置、基础门、耦合图或后端描述发生变化后，未更改的量子电路可能会转换为不同的特定于目标的实现。这种转译漂移会影响电路深度、门组成、量子位映射和执行行为，但在 CI/CD 管道中很少对其进行监控。本文提出了一种量子 DevOps 工作流程，用于在执行前检测转译漂移。该工作流程根据配置的目标配置文件转换源电路，计算结构漂移指标，在 MLflow 中记录出处和工件，并在 GitHub Actions 中引发可配置的警告或故障。使用代表性电路和目标配置文件，我们展示了漂移检查如何暴露工具链引起的变化并支持再现性审核。该贡献是一个实用的 CI/CD 护栏，使量子编译行为可观察、可测试和可审计。

title: Energetic Cost of Temporal Information Processing in Quantum Reservoirs
abstract: Quantum reservoir computing offers a promising route toward energy-efficient machine learning by processing temporal information with minimal training overhead. Yet, the physical principles linking its energetic cost to computational performance remain largely unexplored. Here we show that, in an interacting spin reservoir, information encoding and information processing are governed by distinct physical mechanisms. In the weak interacting regime, we derive an analytical expression for the average (switching) work, showing that the energetic cost of encoding new inputs is determined by the local response of the reservoir units. In contrast, interactions primarily redistribute the encoded information, generating memory and nonlinear features while only weakly affecting the work. This separation produces opposite correlations between energetic cost and performance for representative linear and nonlinear benchmark tasks. Our results identify the switching work as the energetic signature of information encoding and clarify when energetic efficiency and computational performance are compatible.
summary: 量子库计算通过以最小的训练开销处理时间信息，为实现节能机器学习提供了一条有前途的途径。然而，将其能量成本与计算性能联系起来的物理原理在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们表明，在相互作用的自旋库中，信息编码和信息处理由不同的物理机制控制。在弱相互作用状态下，我们推导了平均（切换）功的解析表达式，表明编码新输入的能量成本由储层单元的局部响应决定。相比之下，交互主要重新分配编码信息，生成记​​忆和非线性特征，同时对工作的影响微弱。这种分离在代表性线性和非线性基准任务的能量成本和性能之间产生了相反的相关性。我们的结果将转换工作确定为信息编码的能量特征，并阐明了能量效率和计算性能何时兼容。

title: Entanglement and non-local magic in a non-unitarily deformed non-Hermitian bipartite system
abstract: Non-Hermitian degeneracies are usually discussed through spectral coalescence, whereas entanglement is a property of eigenvectors and need not be fixed by the eigenvalues alone. We formulate a compact bipartite model that separates these two notions. A Hermitian operator with a degenerate eigenspace is transformed by an invertible non-unitary similarity map. The resulting Hamiltonian is non-Hermitian and retains a non-defective degeneracy at every finite value of the non-Hermiticity parameter. For an exactly solvable two-qubit realization, the right eigenstates evolve continuously from product states to maximally entangled states although the spectrum is unchanged. We distinguish the positive right-state reduced density matrix from the generally non-positive biorthogonal reduction, for which entropy may become complex. The same two-qubit solution gives a closed partial-transpose negativity and a Schmidt-gauged non-local magic. Entanglement grows monotonically with the non-Hermiticity parameter, whereas the non-local magic vanishes for both the product and maximally entangled limits and is largest at an intermediate coupling. In larger bipartite spaces, the Page entropy and Haar-averaged purity provide reference values for eigenstate typicality. These diagnostics separate non-defective degeneracy, exceptional-point sensitivity, Haar-typical entanglement, and non-stabilizer correlations without relying on a proliferation of basis-dependent spectral quantities.
summary:
非厄米简并性通常通过光谱合并来讨论，而纠缠是特征向量的属性，不需要单独通过特征值来固定。我们制定了一个紧凑的二分模型来区分这两个概念。具有简并本征空间的埃尔米特算子通过可逆非酉相似图进行变换。由此产生的哈密顿量是非厄米式的，并且在非厄米性参数的每个有限值处保留无缺陷简并性。对于精确可解的两个量子位实现，尽管光谱不变，但正确的本征态从乘积态连续演化到最大纠缠态。我们将正右态约简密度矩阵与一般的非正双正交约简区分开来，后者的熵可能变得复杂。相同的两个量子位解决方案给出了封闭的部分转置负性和施密特测量的非局部魔力。纠缠随着非厄米性参数单调增长，而非局部魔力对于乘积和最大纠缠极限都消失，并且在中间耦合时最大。

在较大的二分空间中，Page 熵和 Haar 平均纯度为本征态典型性提供了参考值。这些诊断方法可以分离无缺陷简并性、异常点灵敏度、哈尔典型纠缠和非稳定相关性，而不依赖于基础相关光谱量的扩散。

title: Deep Holes in the Clifford Hierarchy
abstract: We determine the covering radius of the topological closure of the single-qubit Clifford hierarchy in $\SU(2)\cong S^3$. This closure is a union of $18$ great circles --- the Clifford--Pauli circles --- and we prove that its covering radius is $\arccos\sqrt{5/6}$. The extremal points, which we call \emph{deep holes}, form a single orbit of size $192$ under left and right multiplication by Clifford gates, and are described in closed form. Equivalently, the minimum over one-qubit unitaries of the all-level Clifford fidelity is $5/6$. The proof rests on two structures attached to the configuration of $18$ planes in $\R^4$: their centered rank-two projectors form an orthonormal basis of the irreducible $\SO(4)$-module $\Sym_0(4)$, and the projection profile of a unit quaternion is exactly its image under the double cover $\SU(2)\to\SO(3)$. These reduce the covering problem to a minimax statement for the $\ell^\infty$-norm on $\SO(3)$ which we solve exactly, classifying its equality cases.
summary: 我们确定 $\SU(2)\cong S^3$ 中单量子位 Clifford 层次结构的拓扑闭包的覆盖半径。这个闭包是 $18$ 大圆 --- Clifford--Pauli 圆 --- 的并集，我们证明它的覆盖半径是 $\arccos\sqrt{5/6}$。极值点，我们称之为\emph{深洞}，在克利福德门的左右乘法下形成大小为$192$的单个轨道，并以封闭形式描述。等价地，所有级别 Clifford 保真度的超过 1 个量子比特的最小单位为 $5/6$。证明依赖于 $\R^4$ 中 $18$ 平面配置的两个结构：它们的中心二阶投影仪形成了不可约 $\SO(4)$ 模块 $\Sym_0(4)$ 的正交基，并且单位四元数的投影轮廓正是其在双层覆盖 $\SU(2)\to\SO(3)$ 下的图像。这些将覆盖问题简化为 $\ell^\infty$-范数在 $\SO(3)$ 上的极小极大陈述，我们精确地解决了这个问题，对其相等情况进行分类。

title: Effect of Strong Field Space-time Features on Vacuum Pair
abstract: The relativistic dynamics of bound states across inertial reference frames are investigated using the computational quantum field theory (CQFT). The results reveal that the spatiotemporal properties of bound states within a given potential well are strictly frame-dependent. Crucially, this spatiotemporal modulation of the external field enables a reduction in the laser intensity threshold required for vacuum electron-positron pair creation. Analytical and numerical calculations demonstrate that this threshold reduction originates from the Lorentz transformation of the four-momentum, which reshapes the vacuum excitation pathways in phase space. By developing CQFT, we establish a comprehensive framework in which relativistic effects intrinsically govern the quantum vacuum decay process
summary: 使用计算量子场论 (CQFT) 研究惯性参考系中束缚态的相对论动力学。结果表明，给定势阱内束缚态的时空特性严格依赖于框架。至关重要的是，这种外场的时空调制能够降低真空电子-正电子对产生所需的激光强度阈值。分析和数值计算表明，这种阈值降低源于四动量的洛伦兹变换，它重塑了相空间中的真空激发路径。通过开发 CQFT，我们建立了一个综合框架，其中相对论效应本质上控制着量子真空衰变过程

title: Quantum discord of Ganssian states in an expanding universe
abstract: We investigate the redistribution of continuous-variable quantum discord within the framework of an expanding universe. We find that quantum discord exhibits stronger sensitivity to the spacetime expansion rate than to the expansion volume. As both the expansion rate and expansion volume increase, the initial quantum discord shared by the two bosonic modes decays, while quantum discord is induced in additional mode pairs by the underlying spacetime expansion, signaling a global redistribution of quantum correlations across the system. Specifically, the induced discord is largest for cross-observer bosonic-antibosonic pairs, followed by same-observer bosonic-antibosonic pairs, and smallest for the pair of antibosonic modes. Furthermore, our quantum discord analysis demonstrates that particles with lower momentum and optimal mass serve as more favorable candidates for extracting information about the expanding universe. This work substantially enriches the theoretical framework of quantum discord in expanding spacetimes, and provides new perspectives as well as a solid theoretical foundation for further investigations.
summary: 我们研究了膨胀宇宙框架内连续变量量子不和谐的重新分布。我们发现量子不和谐对时空膨胀率比对膨胀体积表现出更强的敏感性。随着膨胀率和膨胀体积的增加，两种玻色子模式共享的初始量子不和谐会衰减，而潜在的时空膨胀会在其他模式对中引发量子不和谐，这标志着整个系统中量子相关性的全局重新分布。具体来说，引起的不一致对于跨观察者玻色子-反玻色子对来说是最大的，其次是同一观察者玻色子-反玻色子对，对于反玻色子模式对来说是最小的。此外，我们的量子不和谐分析表明，具有较低动量和最佳质量的粒子是提取有关膨胀宇宙的信息的更有利的候选者。这项工作极大地丰富了时空扩展中量子不和谐的理论框架，为进一步研究提供了新的视角和坚实的理论基础。

title: Dissipation-engineered dual-charger quantum batteries
abstract: Suppressing coherent energy backflow while maintaining extractable energy in a stable nonequilibrium state remains a central challenge for quantum energy storage. Here, we introduce a reservoir-engineered dual-charger quantum battery architecture, in which nonequilibrium dissipation is exploited as a control resource to stabilize useful stored energy. A hot-reservoir-coupled driver supplies excitations, while a cold-reservoir-coupled cache biases the resonant three-body transition toward charging and suppresses the dressed-state coherences responsible for energy backflow. This mechanism establishes a population-inverted steady state with finite ergotropy and converts reversible charger--battery exchange into persistent energy storage. For uniformly spaced multilevel batteries, we show that the stored energy and ergotropy scale approximately linearly with the number of accessible levels, while the stored-energy utilization approaches unity. The accompanying stationary heat current provides a thermodynamic signature of the charging regime. Our results demonstrate dissipation engineering as a strategy for achieving stable and scalable quantum energy storage beyond transient coherent charging protocols.
summary:
抑制相干能量回流，同时将可提取能量保持在稳定的非平衡状态仍然是量子能量存储的核心挑战。在这里，我们介绍了一种储层设计的双充电器量子电池架构，其中利用非平衡耗散作为控制资源来稳定有用的存储能量。热储层耦合驱动器提供激励，而冷储层耦合缓存将谐振三体转变偏向充电，并抑制负责能量回流的修饰状态相干性。该机制建立了具有有限的各向异性的群体反转稳态，并将可逆充电器-电池交换转换为持久能量存储。对于均匀间隔的多级电池，我们表明存储的能量和各向异性与可访问级别的数量大致呈线性关系，而存储的能量利用率接近统一。伴随的稳态热流提供了充电状态的热力学特征。

我们的结果证明耗散工程是一种超越瞬态相干充电协议实现稳定且可扩展的量子能量存储的策略。

title: Born-Oppenheimer, Born-Huang, and exact factorization: quantum geometry and error in analytically transparent benchmark models
abstract: The phrase "potential energy surface" refers to several distinct objects. The Born-Oppenheimer construction gives a clamped-nucleus electronic eigenvalue, the single-surface Born-Huang construction adds the diagonal correction, and exact factorization gives a state-dependent exact scalar potential. These constructions answer different questions and should not be regarded as competing definitions of one universal surface. We compare them in two analytically transparent benchmark models. For Fernández's bilinearly coupled oscillators, the exact molecular spectrum, the Born-Oppenheimer and Born-Huang spectra, and the ground-state exact-factorization surface are obtained in closed form. We prove the ground-state ordering of these energies for every admissible mass ratio and coupling and show why it does not extend uniformly to excited states. The diagonal Born-Huang correction is identified with the mass-weighted quantum metric, and Fernández's sixth-order result is recast as a leading geometric error budget involving the metric and a gap-weighted spectral moment of the same derivative couplings. In a linear vibronic-coupling model the metric localizes at an avoided crossing while the total Fubini-Study length remains $\pi/2$, separating the localization of electronic-state change from its total magnitude. Exact factorization is smooth for the nodeless ground state but becomes increasingly ill-conditioned, while remaining finite, when an excited-state nuclear marginal becomes small. These models separate approximation error, geometric correction, and conditioning in a form that can be checked directly.
summary:
短语“势能面”指的是几个不同的物体。玻恩-奥本海默结构给出了钳位核电子特征值，单表面玻恩-黄结构增加了对角线校正，精确分解给出了状态相关的精确标量势。这些结构回答了不同的问题，不应被视为对一个通用表面的相互竞争的定义。我们在两个分析透明的基准模型中对它们进行比较。对于 Fernández 的双线性耦合振子，可以以封闭形式获得精确的分子谱、Born-Oppenheimer 和 Born-Huang 谱以及基态精确因子分解表面。我们证明了这些能量对于每个允许的质量比和耦合的基态排序，并说明了为什么它不能均匀地扩展到激发态。对角 Born-Huang 校正用质量加权量子度量来识别，费尔南德斯的六阶结果被重新定义为主要的几何误差预算，涉及度量和相同导数耦合的间隙加权谱矩。

在线性振动耦合模型中，度量定位在避免的交叉处，而富比尼研究的总长度保持$\pi/2$，将电子态变化的定位与其总大小分开。对于无节点基态，精确分解是平滑的，但当激发态核边缘变小时，它会变得越来越病态，同时保持有限。这些模型以可直接检查的形式将近似误差、几何校正和调节分开。

title: Point-gap topology in amorphous non-Hermitian quantum systems
abstract: Recent studies have revealed that not only does the correspondence between spectral winding numbers and skin modes break down in non-Hermitian systems, but the energy spectrum itself is highly sensitive to generic perturbations, system size, and boundary conditions. In amorphous non-Hermitian systems, where the positions of lattice sites are uncertain, the spectral instability becomes even more severe, making it difficult to identify stable topological edge states from the eigenvalue spectrum alone. To overcome this challenge, we introduce a correspondence between stable zero-mode singular states and mid-gap states of the energy spectrum in the thermodynamic limit. Because the singular value spectrum is highly robust against small perturbations and variation in size, topological edge states can be reliably probed via singular values even in finite-sized systems. Based on the singular-value decomposition of the Hamiltonian, we construct a topological invariant in real space to characterize the associated topologically protected edge states. Our approach provides a general strategy for exploring point-gap topology in real space and redefine the non-Hermitian skin effect from a new perspective.
summary:
最近的研究表明，不仅非厄米系统中谱缠绕数和集肤模式之间的对应关系被打破，而且能谱本身对一般扰动、系统尺寸和边界条件高度敏感。在非晶态非厄米系统中，晶格位置不确定，谱不稳定性变得更加严重，使得仅从特征值谱中识别稳定的拓扑边缘态变得困难。为了克服这一挑战，我们引入了热力学极限下能谱的稳定零模式奇异态和中带隙态之间的对应关系。由于奇异值谱对于小扰动和尺寸变化具有高度鲁棒性，因此即使在有限尺寸的系统中也可以通过奇异值可靠地探测拓扑边缘状态。基于哈密顿量的奇异值分解，我们构造了实空间中的拓扑不变量来表征相关的拓扑保护边缘状态。

我们的方法提供了探索真实空间中点间隙拓扑的通用策略，并从新的角度重新定义非厄米集肤效应。

title: A Resource-Efficient Quantum Framework for Graph Coloring and Chromatic Number Estimation
abstract: Many industrial optimization tasks can be modeled as graph coloring, where adjacent vertices must have different colors. This NP-hard problem is challenging for large graphs. We present a quantum encoding requiring qubits that scale logarithmically with the number of colors and linearly with vertices. Using adiabatic evolution with a novel mixer Hamiltonian and vertex terms, we compute the chromatic number and demonstrate robustness by solving constrained truck loading problems.
summary: 许多工业优化任务可以建模为图形着色，其中相邻顶点必须具有不同的颜色。这个 NP 难题对于大型图来说具有挑战性。我们提出了一种量子编码，要求量子位随颜色数量对数缩放并与顶点线性缩放。使用绝热演化与新型混合器哈密顿量和顶点项，我们计算色数并通过解决约束卡车装载问题来证明鲁棒性。

title: Symmetry Constraints Regularize Neural Quantum State Learning
abstract: Neural quantum states (NQS) offer highly expressive variational wavefunctions, but their optimization is frequently bottlenecked by redundant parameters and poorly conditioned landscapes. We demonstrate that embedding Hamiltonian symmetries directly into the variational parameterization geometrically regularizes this learning problem. For Boltzmann-family NQS, we enforce symmetries by tying local Pauli-$Z$ generators along physical geometric orbits, analytically collapsing the trainable coefficient space prior to optimization. To quantify the resulting optimization geometry, we introduce a geometric metric built on the Jacobian and Hessian of the optimization landscape. This framework evaluates the fraction of the physically accessible state space that corresponds to high-quality, low-energy solutions. Evaluating our approach on transverse-field Ising (TFIM) and XXZ spin chains shows that symmetry compilation excises the vast majority of parameters while maintaining ground-state accuracy within the resolution of the reported benchmarks. In large TFIM systems, strong spatial constraints compress thousands of parameters down to tens, delivering substantial runtime accelerations. Our geometric diagnostics indicate that symmetry produces a more favorable target-aware geometry by concentrating the reachable state space around low-energy solutions while retaining broad target basins. Together, our results indicate that symmetry compilation concentrates the expressive power of NQS on states relevant to the target problem, thereby reducing model size and training cost without sacrificing accuracy.
summary:
神经量子态（NQS）提供了高度表现力的变分波函数，但它们的优化经常受到冗余参数和条件不良的景观的瓶颈。我们证明，将哈密顿对称性直接嵌入到变分参数化中可以几何正则化这个学习问题。对于玻尔兹曼族 NQS，我们通过沿物理几何轨道绑定局部 Pauli-$Z$ 生成器来强制对称性，在优化之前分析性地折叠可训练系数空间。为了量化生成的优化几何，我们引入了基于优化景观的雅可比行列式和海森行列式的几何度量。该框架评估了与高质量、低能耗解决方案相对应的物理可访问状态空间的比例。评估我们的横向场 Ising (TFIM) 和 XXZ 自旋链方法表明，对称编译消除了绝大多数参数，同时在报告的基准分辨率内保持基态精度。在大型 TFIM 系统中，强大的空间约束将数千个参数压缩到数十个，从而提供显着的运行时加速。

我们的几何诊断表明，对称性通过将可达状态空间集中在低能量解决方案周围，同时保留广泛的目标盆地，从而产生更有利的目标感知几何结构。总之，我们的结果表明，对称编译将 NQS 的表达能力集中在与目标问题相关的状态上，从而在不牺牲准确性的情况下减少模型大小和训练成本。

title: Two-copy distillability of one-copy-undistillable negative-partial-transpose states in every dimension
abstract: Whether negative-partial-transpose (NPT) states that are undistillable from one copy become distillable from finitely many copies remains a basic open problem in entanglement theory. We study the canonical two-parameter family of DiVincenzo \textit{et al.}, introduced as a symmetry-reduced testbed for this question. We prove that a distinguished one-copy-undistillable state in this family is already two-copy distillable in every local dimension $d\geq 3$. A uniform equal-norm tight-frame construction gives explicit Schmidt-rank-two certificates in every dimension, thereby disproving the conjecture that the entire one-copy-undistillable region of the canonical family remains undistillable for arbitrarily many copies. The same witnesses certify an open two-copy-distillable neighborhood around the counterexample, while separately constructed three-copy witnesses enlarge the inner bounds for the distillable region in the surrounding parameter space. In contrast, recent results for Werner states, together with the propagation argument of DiVincenzo \textit{et al.}, establish a neighboring region of one-copy-undistillable states that remains two-copy undistillable. Thus a single symmetry-reduced family contains rigorously certified states with opposite two-copy behavior, separated by a substantial region whose finite-copy distillability remains unresolved.
summary:
负部分转置（NPT）状态是否无法从一个副本中提取出来，是否可以从有限多个副本中提取仍然是纠缠理论中的一个基本开放问题。我们研究了 DiVincenzo \textit{et al.} 的规范二参数族，它是作为该问题的对称性降低测试平台而引入的。我们证明，该族中的一个杰出的单副本不可蒸馏状态在每个局部维度 $d\geq 3$ 中已经是两个副本可蒸馏的。统一的等范数紧框架结构在每个维度上都给出了明确的施密特二级证书，从而反驳了规范族的整个单副本不可蒸馏区域对于任意多个副本仍然不可蒸馏的猜想。相同的见证人证明反例周围有一个开放的两副本可蒸馏邻域，而单独构造的三副本见证人扩大了周围参数空间中可蒸馏区域的内部边界。相比之下，维尔纳态的最新结果，以及 DiVincenzo \textit{et al.} 的传播论证，建立了一个单副本不可蒸馏状态的邻近区域，该区域仍然是两个副本不可蒸馏的。

因此，单个对称性降低的族包含经过严格认证的具有相反的两拷贝行为的状态，由一个其有限拷贝蒸馏性仍未解决的实质性区域分隔开。

title: The Logic of Partitions and Partition Logics: Ore's Correspondence, Contextual Pasting, and Direct-Sum Decompositions
abstract: The term ``partition logic'' denotes two constructions at different levels. In automaton and generalized-urn models, selected partitions generate Boolean event algebras whose contextwise union forms a concrete pasted event structure; in Ellerman's framework, whole partitions are classifications governed by refinement and partition operations. For a finite set $U$, Ore's correspondence maps each generator $\pi$ to its Boolean algebra $\BA(\pi)$, but it neither identifies the pasted carrier with $\Part(U)$ nor makes pasting a partition operation. It yields $\BA(\pi\wedge\sigma)=\BA(\pi)\cap\BA(\sigma)$ and $\BA(\pi\vee\sigma)=\langle\BA(\pi)\cup\BA(\sigma)\rangle_{\rm BA}$, where $\langle\cdot\rangle_{\rm BA}$ denotes Boolean-algebra generation. Thus meet captures the common event algebra, whereas join gives the ambient Boolean closure. Chinese-lantern, Firefly, and triangular examples distinguish shared events, atomic intertwining, and inherited concrete order. Ellerman's direct-sum decompositions (DSDs) provide a vector-space analogue: component projections of an orthogonal DSD resolve the identity and encode exclusive outcomes, but its components are not equivalence classes of vectors. Gleason and Kochen--Specker applications require globally context-consistent valuations on those projections.
summary:
术语“分区逻辑”表示不同级别的两种构造。在自动机和广义瓮模型中，选定的分区生成布尔事件代数，其上下文联合形成具体的粘贴事件结构；在埃勒曼的框架中，整个分区是由细化和分区操作控制的分类。对于有限集 $U$，Ore 的对应关系将每个生成器 $\pi$ 映射到其布尔代数 $\BA(\pi)$，但它既不使用 $\Part(U)$ 来标识粘贴的载体，也不进行分区操作。它产生 $\BA(\pi\wedge\sigma)=\BA(\pi)\cap\BA(\sigma)$ 和 $\BA(\pi\vee\sigma)=\langle\BA(\pi)\cup\BA(\sigma)\rangle_{\rm BA}$，其中 $\langle\cdot\rangle_{\rm BA}$ 表示布尔代数生成。因此， meet 捕获公共事件代数，而 join 给出环境布尔闭包。中国灯笼、萤火虫和三角形的例子区分了共享事件、原子交织和继承的具体顺序。

Ellerman 的直接和分解 (DSD) 提供了向量空间类似物：正交 DSD 的分量投影解析恒等式并编码排他结果，但其分量不是向量的等价类。 Gleason 和 Kochen——Specker 应用程序需要对这些预测进行全球范围内一致的评估。

title: Universal entropic occupation statistics in disordered bosonic resonators
abstract: Programmable microcavities support grand-canonical photon gases. We show that bosonic state counting creates an entropic staircase of most-probable total occupations. For detuning density continuous and nonzero at the chemical-potential threshold, the active-cell fraction is asymptotically linear at low temperature and the conditional law has a universal limit; for uniform disorder the law is exact over a finite temperature interval. For two modes it is the Gauss--Kuzmin distribution, linking photonic thermodynamics and metric number theory. We outline finite-array and dye-microcavity tests.
summary: 可编程微腔支持大规范光子气体。我们证明，玻色子态计数创建了最可能总占据的熵阶梯。对于化学势阈值处的失谐密度连续且非零，活性细胞分数在低温下是渐近线性的，并且条件定律具有普遍极限；对于均匀无序，该定律在有限的温度区间内是精确的。对于两种模式，它是高斯-库兹明分布，将光子热力学和度量数论联系起来。我们概述了有限阵列和染料微腔测试。

title: A Heterogeneous Distributed Architecture for Quantum Simulation
abstract: Architectural specialization and distribution can help scale fault-tolerant quantum computers, but may also introduce substantial overheads from communication, routing, and resource duplication. We introduce a heterogeneous distributed architecture in which a magic core is connected to an extensible storage system composed of one-dimensional lanes of specialized cold-storage nodes. The storage system supports parallel random access to Pauli string parities. This organization is particularly well suited to fermionic quantum simulation, enabling parallel execution of the highly non-local Pauli strings arising from these systems. We evaluate the architecture on fault-tolerant simulations of the dynamics of the Fermi-Hubbard and sparse Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) models on systems of up to 450 logical qubits. These workloads exhibit complementary communication structures: Fermi-Hubbard produces a spectrum of interactions from local to non-local shaped by lattice geometry, whereas sparse SYK produces highly non-local and overlapping Pauli operators. For a Trotter step of a 450-logical-qubit Fermi-Hubbard workload, a six-lane system with 30 T-state factories is within approximately $1.4\times$ the wall-clock time of a homogeneous distributed architecture with 4 times as many T-state factories and substantially greater connectivity and sites for injecting magic. For matched T-factory counts, our architecture is $\sim 2\times$ faster.
summary:
架构专业化和分布式可以帮助扩展容错量子计算机，但也可能会因通信、路由和资源重复而带来大量开销。我们引入了一种异构分布式架构，其中魔法核心连接到由专用冷存储节点的一维通道组成的可扩展存储系统。存储系统支持对泡利字符串奇偶校验的并行随机访问。该组织特别适合费米子量子模拟，能够并行执行这些系统产生的高度非局域泡利弦。我们在多达 450 个逻辑量子位的系统上评估费米-哈伯德 (Fermi-Hubbard) 和稀疏 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 模型动力学的容错模拟架构。这些工作负载表现出互补的通信结构：Fermi-Hubbard 产生由晶格几何形状从局部到非局部的一系列相互作用，而稀疏 SYK 产生高度非局部和重叠的泡利算子。

对于 450 个逻辑量子位 Fermi-Hubbard 工作负载的 Trotter 步骤，具有 30 个 T 状态工厂的六通道系统比同质分布式架构的挂钟时间大约在 1.4 美元\倍之内，该架构具有 4 倍的 T 状态工厂以及更大的连接性和注入魔力的站点。对于匹配的 T 工厂计数，我们的架构速度快了 $\sim 2\times$。

title: High-fidelity controlled-phase gates for distinguishable quantum walkers via extended interactions
abstract: We investigate the implementation of controlled-phase (CP) gates with quantum walks in a dual-rail encoding through the use of interacting particles. While previous proposals have focused on indistinguishable particles (bosons or fermions) to achieve unitary fidelity for plane-wave scattering, practical implementations require finite-size wavepackets and routing through single-particle gates, both factors that introduce unavoidable fidelity losses. We show that extending the interaction range beyond on-site or first-neighbor terms provides sufficient control over the scattering potential to engineer CP gates with distinguishable particles that match the ideal bosonic/fermionic performance. For finite Gaussian wavepackets, we derive analytical approximations for the gate fidelity in terms of the transmission coefficient's magnitude and phase derivatives. We find that while distinguishable-particle scattering alone exhibits slightly lower fidelity than the indistinguishable case, the overall architecture that we propose avoids the additional single-particle gates required for routing indistinguishable particles. The roundabout gates needed for the latter indeed introduce fidelity losses approximately one order of magnitude larger than the interaction-induced losses, making the distinguishable-particle approach competitive for practical implementations. Our results establish multi-neighbor interactions as a tool for quantum information processing with continuous-time quantum walks and provide quantitative guidelines for optimizing gate fidelities in finite-size systems.
summary:
我们研究了通过使用相互作用粒子在双轨编码中实现具有量子行走的受控相位（CP）门。虽然之前的提议主要集中在无法区分的粒子（玻色子或费米子）上，以实现平面波散射的统一保真度，但实际的实现需要有限尺寸的波包和通过单粒子门的路由，这两个因素都会带来不可避免的保真度损失。我们表明，将相互作用范围扩展到现场或第一邻项之外，可以充分控制散射势，从而用可区分的粒子设计 CP 门，以匹配理想的玻色子/费米子性能。对于有限高斯波包，我们根据传输系数的幅度和相位导数推导出门保真度的解析近似。我们发现，虽然可区分粒子散射本身的保真度比不可区分的情况稍低，但我们提出的整体架构避免了路由不可区分粒子所需的额外单粒子门。

后者所需的迂回门确实引入了比相互作用引起的损失大约大一个数量级的保真度损失，使得可区分粒子方法在实际实现中具有竞争力。我们的结果建立了多邻域交互作为连续时间量子行走的量子信息处理工具，并为优化有限尺寸系统中的门保真度提供了定量指南。

title: Probing Non-equilibrium baths: Frequency-Resolved Thermometry and Quantum Heat Current Turnover
abstract: Quantum heat transport for non-equilibrium steady state (NESS) exhibits a characteristic turnover effect, where the heat current reaches a maximum and subsequently declines as system-bath coupling increases. Although numerically exact methods can simulate this non-monotonic behavior, they offer limited information on the thermal state of the heat baths. Here, we introduce a frequency-selective thermometric protocol to probe the baths sustaining an NESS. By extracting a frequency-resolved effective temperature spectrum using a tunable two-level probe, we demonstrate that spectral dispersion serves as a direct witness for the non-equilibrium state of the heat baths. To demonstrate the protocol, we applied the hierarchical equations of motion to spin-boson and two-qubit models, though any exact method can be used. For both models, the turnover effect can be explained by how the thermal state of the heat baths evolves as the system-bath coupling strength increases.
summary: 非平衡稳态（NESS）的量子热传输表现出特征转换效应，其中热流达到最大值，然后随着系统-浴耦合的增加而下降。尽管数值精确的方法可以模拟这种非单调行为，但它们提供的有关热浴热状态的信息有限。在这里，我们引入了一种频率选择性测温方案来探测维持 NESS 的浴槽。通过使用可调谐两级探头提取频率分辨的有效温度谱，我们证明光谱色散可以作为热浴非平衡状态的直接见证。为了演示该协议，我们将分层运动方程应用于自旋玻色子和二量子位模型，尽管可以使用任何精确的方法。对于这两种模型，周转效应可以通过热浴的热状态如何随着系统-浴耦合强度的增加而演变来解释。

title: Autoregressive Projective Quantum Monte Carlo: From a Hermitian to a Non-Hermitian Perspective
abstract: Accurately determining the ground-state properties of quantum many-body systems remains a central challenge. In this work, we introduce an autoregressive projective quantum Monte Carlo (PQMC) framework that leverages recurrent neural networks (RNNs) to guide the stochastic dynamics. By incorporating autoregressive sampling into PQMC, we demonstrate substantial improvements in accuracy compared to standard unguided PQMC, while retaining polynomial computational cost. We benchmark our approach against conventional variational RNN ansätze and find that the autoregressive PQMC consistently achieves lower energies and higher fidelity, regardless of system size or whether the Hamiltonian is Hermitian or non-Hermitian. Our results highlight the versatility and power of neural-guided PQMC methods, paving the way for promising scalable simulations of low-energy states in complex quantum many-body systems.
summary: 准确确定量子多体系统的基态特性仍然是一个核心挑战。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种自回归投影量子蒙特卡罗（PQMC）框架，该框架利用循环神经网络（RNN）来指导随机动力学。通过将自回归采样纳入 PQMC，我们证明了与标准无引导 PQMC 相比，精度有了显着提高，同时保留了多项式计算成本。我们将我们的方法与传统的变分 RNN ansätze 进行基准测试，发现自回归 PQMC 始终能够实现更低的能量和更高的保真度，无论系统大小或哈密顿量是厄米式还是非厄米式。我们的结果凸显了神经引导 PQMC 方法的多功能性和强大功能，为复杂量子多体系统中低能态的可扩展模拟铺平了道路。

title: Faster Algorithms for Multimarginal Optimal Transport
abstract: We study algorithms for approximating the multimarginal optimal transport (MOT) distance, a generalization of the classic optimal transport distance, between $m$ discrete probability distributions each supported on at most $n$ points. We give a classical algorithm that computes a coupling between these marginals whose expected transportation cost is within an additive $\varepsilon > 0$ of the MOT distance in time $O(m^2 n^m \varepsilon^{-1}\mathrm{polylog}(m,n,\varepsilon^{-1}))$. This is, to our knowledge, the first bound for general MOT problems with simultaneous linear dependence on the dimension $n^m$ and on the accuracy parameter $\varepsilon^{-1}$, improving the prior state of the art. On the quantum side, we give two algorithms that achieve speedups in dimension, though with worse accuracy dependence than classical approaches. First, we construct a quantum projected subgradient method for estimating the MOT distance within an additive $\varepsilon >0$ with runtime $O( m^3 n^{\frac{m}{2}+1} \varepsilon^{-2} \mathrm{polylog}(m,n,\varepsilon^{-1}))$. This algorithm works with the linear programming dual of the MOT problem, and does not return a coupling. We also give a quantum multimarginal Sinkhorn algorithm for entropy-regularized MOT. This algorithm returns an implicit description of an approximately optimal coupling with runtime $O(m^8n^{\frac{m+1}{2}} \varepsilon^{-5} \mathrm{polylog}(m,n,\varepsilon^{-1})))$ after the usual reduction from entropic MOT to unregularized MOT. We also record query lower bounds: for any precision $\varepsilon<1/2$, randomized classical algorithms require $\Omega(n^m/(1+\varepsilon n))$ queries and quantum algorithms require $\Omega(\sqrt{n^m/(1+\varepsilon n)})$ queries.
summary:
我们研究了近似多边缘最优传输（MOT）距离的算法，这是经典最优传输距离的推广，在 $m$ 个离散概率分布之间，每个概率分布最多支持 $n$ 个点。我们给出了一个经典算法，计算这些边际之间的耦合，其预期运输成本在时间 $O(m^2 n^m \varepsilon^{-1}\mathrm{polylog}(m,n,\varepsilon^{-1}))$ 的 MOT 距离的加性 $\varepsilon > 0$ 内。据我们所知，这是一般 MOT 问题的第一个界限，同时线性依赖于维度 $n^m$ 和精度参数 $\varepsilon^{-1}$，从而改进了现有技术。在量子方面，我们给出了两种实现维度加速的算法，尽管精度依赖性比经典方法更差。首先，我们构建了一种量子投影次梯度方法，用于估计运行时 $O( m^3 n^{\frac{m}{2}+1} \varepsilon^{-2} \mathrm{polylog}(m,n,\varepsilon^{-1}))$ 的加法 $\varepsilon >0$ 内的 MOT 距离。该算法适用于 MOT 问题的线性规划对偶，并且不返回耦合。

我们还给出了熵正则化 MOT 的量子多边际 Sinkhorn 算法。该算法返回与运行时 $O(m^8n^{\frac{m+1}{2}} \varepsilon^{-5} \mathrm{polylog}(m,n,\varepsilon^{-1})))$ 近似最佳耦合的隐式描述，然后从熵 MOT 到非正则化 MOT 的通常减少。我们还记录查询下限：对于任何精度 $\varepsilon<1/2$，随机经典算法需要 $\Omega(n^m/(1+\varepsilon n))$ 查询，量子算法需要 $\Omega(\sqrt{n^m/(1+\varepsilon n)})$ 查询。

title: A Highly Accurate Fast Decoding Framework for QLDPC codes Accelerated by Noise Perturbation and Ensemble Decoding
abstract: A well-balanced decoder has been central to the development of modern fault-tolerant quantum computing. However, the inherent topologies of quantum error correcting codes can limit the performance of many well-studied decoding algorithms. In this work, we introduce Noise Assisted Ensemble Decoding (NAED), a highly accurate decoding framework with a significant advantage in real-time speed. NAED constructs an ensemble of Tanner forests, obtained as acyclic subgraphs of the original Tanner graph, and performs exact inference on each Tanner forest using a lightweight dynamic programming algorithm. The forest construction is guided by synthetic soft information derived jointly from the measured syndrome and channel statistics, with controlled noise perturbations generating diverse yet informative decoding matrix column orderings for the Tanner forest construction across the ensemble. Our benchmark results show that the proposed synthetic soft information-driven construction and inference on the Tanner forests can achieve improved or comparable decoding performances to the state-of-the-art decoding solutions, such as BP+OSD$0$, while also providing orders-of-magnitude improvements in per-round decoding speed under circuit-level noise.
summary:
平衡良好的解码器一直是现代容错量子计算发展的核心。然而，量子纠错码的固有拓扑结构可能会限制许多经过充分研究的解码算法的性能。在这项工作中，我们引入了噪声辅助集成解码（NAED），这是一种高精度解码框架，在实时速度方面具有显着优势。 NAED 构建 Tanner 森林的集合，作为原始 Tanner 图的非循环子图获得，并使用轻量级动态规划算法对每个 Tanner 森林执行精确推理。森林构建由从测量的综合症和通道统计数据联合导出的合成软信息指导，受控的噪声扰动为整个整体的坦纳森林构建生成多样化但信息丰富的解码矩阵列排序。

我们的基准测试结果表明，所提出的合成软信息驱动构建和 Tanner 森林推理可以实现与最先进的解码解决方案（例如 BP+OSD$0$）相比的改进或相当的解码性能，同时还在电路级噪声下每轮解码速度提供数量级的改进。

title: A Design Space Study of Density Matrix Parameterizations for Diffusion-Based Quantum State Tomography
abstract: Diffusion-based quantum state tomography (QST) has shown promising results, but all existing methods implicitly adopt a single parameterization---typically Cholesky---without systematic evaluation. We present a design space study of density matrix parameterizations for diffusion QST, introducing a geometric framework based on the Jacobian Gram matrix $\mathbf{J}^\top\mathbf{J}$ that quantifies two competing criteria: isometric conditioning and physical constraint satisfaction. Our calibration of seven parameterizations at 2- and 3-qubit scales reveals three key findings. First, isometry and constraints are orthogonal criteria---no single parameterization optimizes both. Second, theoretical elegance does not predict geometric quality: the exponential map exhibits a spectral range of $149\times$ at 2 qubits and $75\,658\times$ at 3 qubits, while simpler parameterizations remain well-conditioned. Third, geometric conditioning alone does not fully predict end-to-end performance: without classifier-free guidance (CFG), Hermitian direct outperforms Bloch despite worse local isometry; under CFG, the ranking reverses due to amplified boundary effects. End-to-end training confirms that better-conditioned parameterizations converge faster and achieve higher fidelity in the absence of CFG. We provide actionable selection guidelines to guide future QST method design.
summary:
基于扩散的量子态断层扫描 (QST) 已显示出有希望的结果，但所有现有方法都隐含地采用单一参数化（通常是 Cholesky），而没有进行系统评估。我们提出了扩散 QST 密度矩阵参数化的设计空间研究，引入了基于雅可比格拉姆矩阵 $\mathbf{J}^\top\mathbf{J}$ 的几何框架，该框架量化了两个相互竞争的标准：等距调节和物理约束满足。我们对 2 和 3 量子位尺度的七个参数化的校准揭示了三个关键发现。首先，等距和约束是正交标准——没有单一参数化可以同时优化两者。其次，理论上的优雅并不能预测几何质量：指数图在 2 个量子位处表现出 $149\times$ 的光谱范围，在 3 个量子位处表现出 $75\,658\times$ 的光谱范围，而更简单的参数化仍然保持良好状态。第三，仅靠几何条件并不能完全预测端到端性能：在没有无分类器引导（CFG）的情况下，尽管局部等距较差，Hermitian 直接优于 Bloch；在 CFG 下，由于边界效应放大，排名发生了逆转。

端到端训练证实，在没有 CFG 的情况下，条件更好的参数化可以更快地收敛并实现更高的保真度。我们提供可行的选择指南来指导未来的 QST 方法设计。

title: A Domain-Specific Language for Formulating Hybrid Quantum-Classical Meta-Solver Strategies
abstract: A key challenge when designing hybrid quantum-classical workflows is the identification of quantum candidates, that is, determining for which specific problems quantum advantages could potentially be achieved. When choosing between several candidates, it is crucial to consider the characteristics specific to the problem, as these can fundamentally determine how successful quantum or classical approaches will be. This implies that specialized expertise is needed to use hybrid quantum-classical workflows successfully. To address this challenge, we propose a domain-specific language (DSL) to express best-practices in solution strategies using a universal representation that is easy to use and share. This DSL provides a flexible approach to design hybrid quantum-classical workflows and to automate decisions for a wide range of problems, supporting decisions down to problem-specific details while remaining technically independent. Furthermore, we propose a framework that is built around our DSL that enables the execution of defined workflows using the ProvideQ toolbox as an orchestration layer. All contributions from this publication are open source.
summary: 设计混合量子经典工作流程时的一个关键挑战是识别量子候选者，即确定对于哪些特定问题可能实现量子优势。在几个候选方法之间进行选择时，考虑问题的具体特征至关重要，因为这些特征可以从根本上决定量子或经典方法的成功程度。这意味着需要专门的专业知识才能成功使用混合量子经典工作流程。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种特定领域语言（DSL），使用易于使用和共享的通用表示来表达解决方案策略中的最佳实践。该 DSL 提供了一种灵活的方法来设计混合量子经典工作流程并自动针对各种问题做出决策，支持具体问题特定细节的决策，同时保持技术独立。此外，我们提出了一个围绕我们的 DSL 构建的框架，该框架允许使用 ProvideQ 工具箱作为编排层来执行定义的工作流程。本出版物的所有贡献都是开源的。

title: Memory-, Circuit-, and Ansatz-Efficient VQLS for CFD on Hybrid Quantum-HPC Systems
abstract: Fluid dynamics workloads are dominated by repeated solves of large, structured linear systems, motivating the search for quantum acceleration. The Variational Quantum Linear Solver (VQLS) is a leading near-term candidate, but practical deployment on hybrid quantum--high--performance computing (HPC) systems faces three persistent challenges: (i) the linear-combination-of-unitaries (LCU) encoding of the system matrix explodes in memory and runtime as the problem size grows, (ii) ansatz selection is largely empirical, with no clear link between standard circuit metrics and solver convergence, and (iii) end-to-end VQLS pipelines have rarely been exercised on production HPC hardware at non-trivial qubit counts. This work addresses these challenges through three contributions. First, we benchmark four matrix-encoding strategies---naive LCU, PennyLane-integrated, Fast Walsh--Hadamard Transform (FWHT)-based parallel Pauli decomposition, and an singular value decomposition (SVD)-based two-term LCU---and show that the FWHT approach reduces peak memory by up to $1298\times$ on an $11\times 11$ Hele--Shaw grid, while the SVD-based coherent VQLS delivers over $10{,}000\times$ per-iteration speedup over standard Pauli-based VQLS at 8 qubits. Second, we evaluate 11 ansatz families with gradient-free and gradient-based optimizers on canonical Hele--Shaw flow, and find that expressibility and entanglement metrics correlate only weakly with VQLS convergence, motivating problem-aware ansatz design. Third, we deploy the full workflow on the OLCF Frontier supercomputer and successfully simulate a 15-qubit tridiagonal Toeplitz system on a single node. Together, these results establish a practical baseline for VQLS in hybrid quantum--HPC computation fluid dynamic (CFD) workflows and identify the remaining bottlenecks for larger problems.
summary:
流体动力学工作负载主要是大型结构化线性系统的重复求解，这激发了对量子加速的探索。变分量子线性求解器 (VQLS) 是近期的领先候选者，但混合量子高性能计算 (HPC) 系统的实际部署面临着三个持续的挑战：(i) 随着问题规模的增长，系统矩阵的线性组合酉 (LCU) 编码在内存和运行时会爆炸，(ii) ansatz 选择很大程度上是经验性的，标准电路指标和求解器收敛之间没有明确的联系，(iii) 端到端VQLS 管道很少在具有重要量子比特数的生产 HPC 硬件上使用。这项工作通过三项贡献解决了这些挑战。

首先，我们对四种矩阵编码策略进行基准测试——朴素 LCU、PennyLane 集成、基于 Fast Walsh-Hadamard 变换 (FWHT) 的并行泡利分解和基于奇异值分解 (SVD) 的两项 LCU——并表明 FWHT 方法在 $11\times 11$ Hele-Shaw 网格上将峰值内存减少高达 $1298\times$，而基于 SVD 的相干 VQLS与 8 量子位的基于保利的标准 VQLS 相比，每次迭代加速速度超过 $10{,}000\times$。其次，我们在规范的 Hele-Shaw 流上使用无梯度和基于梯度的优化器评估 11 个 ansatz 系列，发现可表达性和纠缠度量与 VQLS 收敛仅微弱相关，从而激发了问题感知型 ansatz 设计。第三，我们在 OLCF Frontier 超级计算机上部署了完整的工作流程，并在单个节点上成功模拟了 15 量子位三对角 Toeplitz 系统。这些结果共同为混合量子 HPC 计算流体动力学 (CFD) 工作流程中的 VQLS 建立了实用基线，并确定了更大问题的剩余瓶颈。

title: Microscopic QED origin of spin entanglement
abstract: We study effective spin interactions arising from quantum electrodynamics (QED) scattering between localized fermionic spins. By integrating out photon and mediator fields, the dynamics reduce to an effective spin Hamiltonian. For two qubits in the nonrelativistic regime, the resulting interaction takes a tensor dipolar form with an asymptotic decay proportional to \(R^{-3}\). We obtain analytical expressions for the entanglement negativity, highlighting its dependence on coupling strength and spatial configuration. We then examine a setup in which two bath spins interact via a sequential exchange with an intermediate fermionic mediator. At the perturbative order considered, the mediator remains unentangled and induces an effective bath--bath interaction with stronger spatial suppression than in the photon-mediated case. Extending the construction to an \(N\)-spin setting yields an effective interaction network mediated by virtual exchange processes, which can support the generation of multipartite entanglement across the system.
summary: 我们研究局域费米子自旋之间的量子电动力学（QED）散射产生的有效自旋相互作用。通过整合光子和介体场，动力学简化为有效的自旋哈密顿量。对于非相对论状态中的两个量子位，产生的相互作用采用张量偶极形式，渐近衰减与 \(R^{-3}\) 成比例。我们获得了纠缠负性的解析表达式，强调了它对耦合强度和空间构型的依赖性。然后我们检查一个设置，其中两个浴自旋通过与中间费米子介体的顺序交换相互作用。在所考虑的微扰阶中，介体保持未纠缠状态，并诱导有效的浴-浴相互作用，其空间抑制比光子介导的情况更强。将结构扩展到\(N\)-自旋设置会产生一个由虚拟交换过程介导的有效交互网络，它可以支持整个系统中多方纠缠的生成。

title: Spread of Entanglement in Generalized Kicked Ising Chain
abstract: We investigate the dynamics of entanglement in a generalized version of the kicked Ising chain, extending the model from the standard qubit case (local dimension $q=2$) to higher local dimensions ($q > 2$). We identify the existence of ''dual-unitary'' points where the model's space-time duality allows for exact analytical solutions. Our analysis reveals that while a few unique dual-unitary points exist analytically for systems with local dimensions $q=3$ and $q=4$, such points do not exist for $q \ge 5$ due to the lack of a unique kicking strength that satisfies the required matrix element conditions. Utilizing the transfer matrix method and a replica trick specifically adapted for higher dimensions, we derive exact expressions for the growth of entanglement entropy in the $q=3$ (kicked Potts-type) model starting from a class of solvable initial states. Our results demonstrate that at the dual-unitary point, both Rényi and von Neumann entanglement entropies grow linearly with time until reaching a maximum value determined by the subsystem size.
summary: 我们研究了踢伊辛链的广义版本中的纠缠动力学，将模型从标准量子位情况（局部维度 $q=2$）扩展到更高的局部维度（$q > 2$）。我们确定了“双酉”点的存在，其中模型的时空对偶性允许精确的解析解。我们的分析表明，虽然对于局部尺寸 $q=3$ 和 $q=4$ 的系统，分析上存在一些独特的双酉点，但由于缺乏满足所需矩阵元素条件的独特踢击强度，这些点对于 $q \ge 5$ 不存在。利用转移矩阵方法和专门适用于更高维度的复制技巧，我们从一类可解的初始状态开始，推导出 $q=3$（kicked Potts 型）模型中纠缠熵增长的精确表达式。我们的结果表明，在双酉点，Rényi 和冯诺依曼纠缠熵都随时间线性增长，直到达到由子系统大小确定的最大值。

title: State Diagnostics of Complexity in Open Quantum Systems
abstract: We study the emergence of complexity in finite-size quantum systems as their dynamics transition from closed and coherent evolution to interacting and effectively open behavior. Using a state-based geometric framework, we represent mixed quantum states as probability measures on complex projective Hilbert space. This representation allows us to track how interactions reshape the underlying pure-state geometry. We introduce two complementary diagnostics: a distinguishability measure, based on the Wasserstein distance between probability-measure representations of mixed states, that quantifies sensitivity to initial states, and a state-space coverage index that measures long-time exploration of the subsystem state space. These diagnostics provide a geometric perspective on the emergence and evolution of quantum dynamical complexity. When applied to the quantum kicked top, both diagnostics generally increase with interaction strength. Their dependence on environment size is structured by parity symmetry, with integer-spin systems often exhibiting greater sensitivity and state-space coverage than half-integer-spin systems. These results highlight finite-size quantum effects and provide a geometric approach to quantifying dynamical complexity deep in the quantum regime
summary:
我们研究有限尺寸量子系统中复杂性的出现，因为它们从封闭和相干的演化到相互作用和有效的开放行为的动态转变。使用基于状态的几何框架，我们将混合量子态表示为复杂射影希尔伯特空间上的概率度量。这种表示使我们能够跟踪相互作用如何重塑底层的纯态几何。我们引入了两种互补的诊断方法：一种基于混合状态概率测量表示之间的 Wasserstein 距离的可区分性测量，它量化了对初始状态的敏感性；以及一种状态空间覆盖指数，用于测量子系统状态空间的长期探索。这些诊断为量子动力学复杂性的出现和演化提供了几何视角。当应用于量子踢顶时，两种诊断通常都会随着相互作用强度的增加而增加。它们对环境大小的依赖是由奇偶对称性构成的，整数自旋系统通常比半整数自旋系统表现出更高的灵敏度和状态空间覆盖范围。

这些结果突出了有限尺寸的量子效应，并提供了一种量化量子体系深处动态复杂性的几何方法

title: Magic State Distillation via Codes over Binary Extension Fields
abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computation architectures are frequently bottlenecked by the overhead of producing high-fidelity magic states. In this work, we use algebraic geometric techniques to construct codes over binary extension fields $\mathbb{F}_{2^s}$, thus discovering new protocols for the distillation of qubit magic states, where our focus is on the regime of practical qubit-based quantum computing architectures. To do this, we show that multi-qubit gates of interest such as $\text{CS}$, $\text{CCZ}$, and $\text{TOF}\# = \text{CCZ}_{123}\text{CCZ}_{345}$, can be packaged into simple gates over the larger fields, and we derive simple algebraic conditions in the extension fields allowing the distillation of these gates. Because they are derived from Galois qudits, the corresponding qubits codes naturally handle the correlated errors present on such multi-qubit states. Moreover, the protocols we discover are extremely compact; for example, we show that 4 $\text{CS}$ states can be distilled to 1 $\text{CS}$ state at distance 2, using only 4 logical qubits. For a case study, we consider the distillation of $\text{CS}$ and $\text{CCZ}$ states from injected $\text{T}$ and $\text{CS}$ states. When optimized for magic state production per unit time, or logical spacetime volume, we find that our protocols outperform the state-of-the-art in almost every situation, both at input error rates $10^{-3}$ (direct injection), and $10^{-6}$ (allowing some cultivation pre-injection).
summary:
容错量子计算架构经常受到产生高保真魔法状态的开销的瓶颈。在这项工作中，我们使用代数几何技术在二进制扩展域 $\mathbb{F}_{2^s}$ 上构造代码，从而发现用于蒸馏量子位魔态的新协议，其中我们的重点是基于实用量子位的量子计算架构的体系。为此，我们展示了感兴趣的多量子位门，例如 $\text{CS}$、$\text{CCZ}$ 和 $\text{TOF}\# = \text{CCZ}_{123}\text{CCZ}_{345}$，可以打包成更大域上的简单门，并且我们在扩展域中导出简单的代数条件，允许对这些门进行蒸馏。因为它们源自伽罗瓦量子位，所以相应的量子位代码自然地处理这种多量子位状态上存在的相关错误。此外，我们发现的协议非常紧凑；例如，我们证明仅使用 4 个逻辑量子位即可将 4 个 $\text{CS}$ 状态蒸馏为距离 2 处的 1 个 $\text{CS}$ 状态。

对于案例研究，我们考虑从注入的 $\text{T}$ 和 $\text{CS}$ 状态中蒸馏出 $\text{CS}$ 和 $\text{CCZ}$ 状态。当针对单位时间或逻辑时空体积的魔法状态产生进行优化时，我们发现我们的协议在几乎所有情况下都优于最先进的技术，无论是输入错误率 $10^{-3}$ （直接注入）还是 $10^{-6}$ （允许一些培养预注入）。

title: Quantized Stabilizer-Rényi Boundary Response across Fermionic SPT Transitions
abstract: Open boundaries host symmetry-protected Majorana modes, yet their imprint on the stabilizer Rényi entropy is obscured by a nonuniversal volume law. At Rényi index $\alpha=1/2$, we isolate a bulk-subtracted boundary response in free-fermion BDI chains using exact finite-open-chain relations, large-$L$ Pfaffian evaluations, and direct positive-weight checks. Across a mass inversion, this response approaches $|\Delta\omega|\ln 2$, where $\Delta\omega$ is the change in winding number. The response survives primitive bulk deformations, the tested local boundary perturbations, and broken bulk duality. Thus, for the families studied here, the boundary response counts the Majorana channels that change the fermionic SPT index.
summary: 开放边界包含对称保护的马约拉纳模式，但它们在稳定器 Rényi 熵上的印记被非通用体积定律所掩盖。在 Rényi 指数 $\alpha=1/2$ 处，我们使用精确的有限开链关系、大 $L$ Pfaffian 评估和直接正权重检查来隔离自由费米子 BDI 链中的批量减去边界响应。在质量反演过程中，该响应接近 $|\Delta\omega|\ln 2$，其中 $\Delta\omega$ 是绕组数的变化。该响应在原始体积变形、测试的局部边界扰动和破碎的体积二元性中仍然存在。因此，对于此处研究的族，边界响应计算改变费米子 SPT 指数的马约拉纳通道。

title: Quantum Information Flow under String-Diagram Rewriting
abstract: We revisit the notion of ``quantum information flow'' introduced in Bob Coecke's early work and seek to give it an explicit string-diagrammatic formalization. Given a semantics preserving string-diagram rewriting sequence, we first distinguish apparent through-paths, which depend on the current graphical presentation, from genuine through paths, which can be compatibly inherited through successive rewrites to a terminal decoupled bare wire factor. We then formally define a ``Coecke flow line'' in terms of this compatible inheritance relation. In particular, we use the ZX calculus, i.e., the ZX string diagram rewriting system, to illustrate the resulting formalism. In the physical setting of quantum protocols, a Coecke flow can be interpreted as a constrained, quasi-local, line-like presentation of a target bare wire morphism factor within the protocol string diagram.
summary: 我们重新审视鲍勃·科克早期工作中引入的“量子信息流”概念，并寻求给它一个明确的字符串图形式化。给定保留字符串图重写序列的语义，我们首先将取决于当前图形表示的明显直通路径与真正的直通路径区分开来，后者可以通过对终端解耦裸线因子的连续重写来兼容地继承。然后，我们根据这种兼容继承关系正式定义“Coecke 流线”。特别是，我们使用 ZX 演算，即 ZX 字符串图重写系统，来说明由此产生的形式主义。在量子协议的物理设置中，库克流可以解释为协议串图中目标裸线态射因子的受约束、准局部、线状表示。

title: An upper bound for the purity of absolutely positive partial transpose states
abstract: A quantum state is called absolutely separable (resp. absolutely positive partial transpose (APPT)) if it remains separable (resp. positive partial transpose (PPT)) under any global unitary transformation. It is known that the set of all absolutely separable states is a subset of the set of all APPT states. Moreover, these two sets are identical for qubit-qudit systems. In this note, we give an upper bound for the purity of APPT bipartite states (and therefore for the purity of absolutely separable bipartite states). For qubit-qudit systems, this upper bound becomes the maximum purity of APPT (and absolutely separable) states.
summary: 如果量子态在任何全局酉变换下保持可分离（分别为正部分转置（PPT）），则称为绝对可分离（分别为绝对正部分转置（APPT））。已知所有绝对可分离状态的集合是所有APPT状态集合的子集。此外，对于 qubit-qudit 系统来说，这两组是相同的。在本文中，我们给出了 APPT 二分态纯度的上限（因此也给出了绝对可分离二分态纯度的上限）。对于 qubit-qudit 系统，这个上限成为 APPT（和绝对可分离）状态的最大纯度。

title: Learning Clifford-structured quantum unitaries and Hamiltonians
abstract: Learning algorithms for structured quantum unitaries and Hamiltonians have primarily considered classes of processes that are local or sparse in the Pauli basis. We turn our attention to learning $n$-qubit quantum unitaries $U$ and Hamiltonians $H$, given query access to $U$ or the unitary evolution of $H$, that may be dense in the Pauli basis but still admit concise Clifford decompositions. Specifically, we consider unitaries (or Hamiltonians) of the form $U = \sum_i \alpha_i C_i$ over Cliffords $C_i$ with bounded Clifford extent $\sum_i |\alpha_i|$. To extract this Clifford structure, we introduce an agnostic tomography protocol for Clifford unitaries that given query access to an unknown unitary $U$ with optimal Clifford fidelity $\textsf{opt}$, outputs a Clifford unitary witnessing fidelity $\geq \textsf{opt} - \varepsilon$ for some error $\varepsilon > 0$, in time $\textsf{poly}(n,(1/\varepsilon)^{\log(1/\varepsilon)})$. We then apply this protocol to obtain tomography protocols for unitaries and Hamiltonians that have bounded Clifford extent. This extends learnability of Hamiltonians from those with sparse Pauli decompositions to those that are dense (i.e., has sparsity $\Omega(2^n)$) in the Pauli basis but are Clifford structured.
summary:
结构化量子酉和哈密顿量的学习算法主要考虑泡利基中局部或稀疏的过程类别。我们将注意力转向学习$n$-量子位量子酉$U$和哈密顿量$H$，给定对$U$的查询访问或$H$的酉演化，这在泡利基中可能是稠密的，但仍然允许简洁的克利福德分解。具体来说，我们考虑 $U = \sum_i \alpha_i C_i$ 形式的酉元（或哈密顿量）在 Cliffords $C_i$ 上，且 Clifford 范围为 $\sum_i |\alpha_i|$。为了提取这个 Clifford 结构，我们为 Clifford 酉引入了一种不可知的断层扫描协议，该协议以最佳 Clifford 保真度 $\textsf{opt}$ 给出对未知酉 $U$ 的查询访问，及时输出 Clifford 酉见证保真度 $\geq \textsf{opt} - \varepsilon$ 对于某些错误 $\varepsilon > 0$ $\textsf{poly}(n,(1/\varepsilon)^{\log(1/\varepsilon)})$。然后，我们应用该协议来获取具有克利福德范围边界的幺正和哈密顿量的断层扫描协议。

这将哈密顿量的可学习性从具有稀疏泡利分解的那些扩展到那些在泡利基中具有稀疏性 $\Omega(2^n)$ 但具有 Clifford 结构的稠密分解（即具有稀疏性 $\Omega(2^n)$）。

title: From Koszul-Complex Stabilizer Models to Superselection Profiles: Topological Rigidity and Nonsplit Extensions
abstract: Koszul-complex stabilizer models unify the toric-code hierarchy and bivariate-bicycle codes in one homological framework. To study translation-symmetry-enriched topological (SET) phases in these models and, more generally, in translation-invariant Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) codes with stabilizer maps $(\varphi_X,\varphi_Z)$, we introduce the associated topological superselection profile $\mathscr S_\sigma:=\tau_{\geq1}\mathbf R\!\operatorname{Hom}_R(\overline{\operatorname{coker}\varphi_\sigma},R),\ \sigma=X,Z$. Its cohomology layers $E_\sigma^\ell:=H^\ell(\mathscr S_\sigma)\cong_R\operatorname{Ext}_R^\ell(\overline{\operatorname{coker}\varphi_\sigma},R)$ encode sectors, fusion, and translation action. When finite, the $\ell=1,2,\ldots$ layers describe pointlike, looplike, and higher-dimensional excitations; $\mathscr S_\sigma$ retains inter-layer gluing. For regular Koszul models, we compute $E_\sigma^\ell$ explicitly, find $\mathscr S_\sigma$ single-layer, and obtain finite-size $Z$-logicals from $\operatorname{Tor}$. Single-layer means that at most one positive-degree layer $E_\sigma^\ell$ is nonzero. Our matrix-level Schanuel-lemma method proves rigidity: under a finite-resolution hypothesis, the nonzero layer and degree uniquely determine a topological CSS code's translation SET order at the stable translation-invariant Clifford level. For prime qudits the hypothesis is automatic, and a finite layer's translation kernel gives the exact minimal coarse graining to a toric-code stack. We realize admissible single-layer data. Beyond this regime, split and nonsplit extensions of 3D qubit toric codes yield eight models sharing all identical $E_\sigma^\ell$ layers with trivial translation action but having distinct size-dependent ground-state degeneracies, hence distinct translation SET phases. Thus inter-layer gluing carries SET data invisible to individual layers.
summary:
Koszul 复合稳定器模型将环面代码层次结构和双变量自行车代码统一在一个同源框架中。为了研究这些模型中的平移对称丰富的拓扑 (SET) 相，更一般地，在具有稳定器映射 $(\varphi_X,\varphi_Z)$ 的平移不变 Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) 代码中，我们引入了相关的拓扑超选择配置文件 $\mathscr S_\sigma:=\tau_{\geq1}\mathbf R\!\operatorname{Hom}_R(\overline{\operatorname{coker}\varphi_\sigma},R),\ \sigma=X,Z$.它的上同调层 $E_\sigma^\ell:=H^\ell(\mathscr S_\sigma)\cong_R\operatorname{Ext}_R^\ell(\overline{\operatorname{coker}\varphi_\sigma},R)$ 编码扇区、融合和平移动作。当有限时，$\ell=1,2,\ldots$层描述点状、环状和更高维的激励； $\mathscr S_\sigma$ 保留层间粘合。对于常规 Koszul 模型，我们显式计算 $E_\sigma^\ell$，找到 $\mathscr S_\sigma$ 单层，并从 $\operatorname{Tor}$ 获得有限大小的 $Z$-逻辑。单层意味着至多一个正度层 $E_\sigma^\ell$ 不为零。

我们的矩阵级 Schanuel 引理方法证明了刚性：在有限分辨率假设下，非零层和度唯一确定稳定平移不变 Clifford 级别上的拓扑 CSS 代码的平移 SET 顺序。对于素数量子，假设是自动的，有限层的翻译内核为环面代码堆栈提供了精确的最小粗粒度。我们实现了可接受的单层数据。除了这个机制之外，3D 量子位环面代码的分裂和非分裂扩展产生八个模型，它们共享所有相同的 $E_\sigma^\ell$ 层，具有微不足道的平移作用，但具有不同的大小相关的基态简并性，因此具有不同的平移 SET 阶段。因此，层间粘合携带着各个层不可见的 SET 数据。

title: Decoupling 2D translation-invariant topological CSS codes
abstract: Two-dimensional translation-invariant topological CSS codes on qubits are known to be locally equivalent, after coarse-graining, to stacks of toric codes. However, existing constructions generally break more translation symmetry than is required to remove anyon-permuting translations, leaving open whether any further obstruction exists. We prove that no such obstruction occurs: after passing to the maximal anyon-preserving superlattice, every such code admits a local unitary decoupling into toric codes and product states. We further provide an efficient algorithm for explicitly constructing the decoupling map, together with bounds on the required supercell size and operator spreading. The decoupling requires no additional ancillas in generic cases and extends to finite systems with suitable boundary conditions.
summary: 已知量子位上的二维平移不变拓扑 CSS 代码在粗粒度化后局部等效于环面代码堆栈。然而，现有的结构通常比消除任意排列翻译所需的翻译对称性破坏更多，从而使是否存在任何进一步的障碍保持开放。我们证明不会发生这样的阻塞：在传递到最大任意子保持超晶格之后，每个这样的代码都承认局部酉解耦为环面代码和乘积状态。我们进一步提供了一种有效的算法，用于显式构建解耦图，以及所需的超单元大小和算子扩展的界限。在一般情况下，解耦不需要额外的辅助设备，并且可以扩展到具有适当边界条件的有限系统。
